item.title: Le copilote de Flydubai voulait s'inspirer du 11-Septembre - procureur
item.description: Le copilote omanais du vol Flydubai à destination d'Israël dérouté le 30 septembre vers l'Arabie saoudite voulait s'emparer des commandes de l'avion et le précipiter sur l'aéroport de Tel Aviv-Ben Gourion, a déclaré vendredi le procureur général des Emirats arabes unis, cité par l'agence officielle émiratie.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le copilote omanais du vol F[USN:L8N45M0TT TEXT:"lydubai"] à destination d'Israël dérouté le 30 septembre vers l'Arabie saoudite voulait s'emparer des commandes de l'avion et le précipiter sur l'aéroport de Tel Aviv-Ben Gourion, a déclaré vendredi le procureur général des Emirats arabes unis, cité par l'agence officielle émiratie. Dans un communiqué présentant de manière détaillée les résultats de l'enquête ouverte le 1er octobre, Hamad Saïf al Chamsi a déclaré que le projet s'inspirait des attentats du 11 septembre 2001 aux Etats-Unis. Le suspect avait déjà effectué deux vols entre Dubaï et Tel Aviv pour "se familiariser avec le trajet et l'aéroport", selon les investigations. Le copilote a blessé le pilote de l'appareil avec la hache de secours du cockpit avant d'être maîtrisé et empêché de parvenir à ses fins par des passagers. Il avait travaillé précédemment pour plusieurs compagnies aériennes dont Oman Air et Royal Air Maroc, avant de rejoindre Flydubai en janvier 2026.

item.title: Holanda e UE estão dispostas a proteger TPI, dizem autoridades
item.description: Países da União Europeia, incluindo o país anfitrião, a Holanda, tomarão medidas para manter o funcionamento do Tribunal Penal Internacional (TPI) após os Estados Unidos imporem sanções contra a corte, afirmaram o primeiro-ministro holandês, Rob Jetten, e o presidente do Conselho da UE, António Costa, em uma coletiva de imprensa conjunta nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Países da União Europeia, incluindo o país anfitrião, a Holanda, tomarão medidas para manter o funcionamento do Tribunal Penal Internacional (TPI) após os Estados Unidos imporem sanções contra a corte, afirmaram o primeiro-ministro holandês, Rob Jetten, e o presidente do Conselho da UE, António Costa, em uma coletiva de imprensa conjunta nesta sexta-feira. item.title: Holland & Knight, other firms disclose data security breaches
item.description: Two more large US law firms, Holland & Knight and Squire Patton Boggs, have disclosed data security breaches to state regulators, and a third was hit with a new proposed class action in federal court over a reported hack.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Two more large US law firms, Holland & Knight and Squire Patton Boggs, have disclosed data security breaches to state regulators, and a third was hit with a new proposed class action in federal court over a reported hack. Holland & Knight, which employs 2,200 lawyers, and the 2,600-attorney Squire Patton Boggs both told Vermont’s state attorney general on Thursday that Social Security numbers were exposed in the incidents that affected the firms. Holland & Knight in a statement said "a threat actor used social engineering techniques to gain unauthorized remote access to a firm computer." It said it "identified the small number of files involved and promptly notified the clients whose information was contained in those files." Squire Patton Boggs in a statement said its incident involved "an unauthorized third party obtaining a limited set of information from the firm." Both firms said there was no disruption to their client services. Separately, law firm Nelson Mullins was sued on Wednesday in federal court in South Carolina for allegedly failing to safeguard private information following a breach at the firm. In a statement, the firm said a cyber group that targets law firms “accessed the laptop of a single user and copied a limited number of documents accessible by this user.” The firm, which employs more than 1,000 lawyers, said the incident “was contained and did not involve any other systems, devices, or accounts.” Nelson Mullins said it was in contact with law enforcement authorities and supporting their investigation. The latest disclosures underscore cybersecurity risks for law firms, which routinely hold sensitive client communications, financial records and personal data that can be valuable to hackers. Recent breaches at major law firms have highlighted how cybercriminals are increasingly targeting the legal industry through tactics including so-called social-engineering schemes designed to gain access to confidential information. Several law firms including WilmerHale and Weil Gotshal have paid a ransom or suppression payment following a data breach. WilmerHale is also facing a lawsuit in DC federal court over its alleged breach. item.title: Sainz, enfadado tras un "error humano" que le frenó en la clasificación para el sprint de Singapur
item.description: Carlos Sainz, de Williams, criticó el viernes a la FIA tras un error de la dirección de carrera que ralentizó a los autos que luchaban por clasificarse para la carrera al sprint de Singapur, afirmando que el fallo le recordó a los problemas de software que se produjeron en el Gran Premio de Baréin, celebrado en Malasia.
item.dc:creator: Tom Westbrook
item.content:encoded: Carlos Sainz, de Williams, criticó el viernes a la FIA tras un error de la dirección de carrera que ralentizó a los autos que luchaban por clasificarse para la carrera al sprint de Singapur, afirmando que el fallo le recordó a los problemas de software que se produjeron en el Gran Premio de Baréin, celebrado en Malasia. Después de que la primera sesión de clasificación para la carrera sprint se suspendió con bandera roja cuando el Cadillac de Sergio "Checo" Pérez se estrelló contra una barrera, el personal de control de carrera reactivó tardíamente el "modo de adelantamiento" durante 27 segundos antes de desactivarlo para el resto de la sesión. El "modo de adelantamiento" proporciona a los pilotos potencia adicional y su activación ayudó a los pilotos que estaban marcando un tiempo de vuelta al final de la sesión, mientras que Sainz quedó eliminado. "La mitad de los autos completaron la vuelta con un motor medio segundo más rápido que los demás. Esta vez hubo otro problema de software con los autos y nosotros salimos perjudicados", afirmó el piloto español. "Por la razón que sea, la FIA, al igual que en Malasia, no decidió aplicar la equidad deportiva y no le importó que la mitad de los autos en la clasificación tuvieran más potencia que la otra mitad", señaló. "Así que me confunde un poco que el deporte siga actuando de forma diferente dependiendo de quién quede fuera en la Q1 (primera sesión de clasificación) o quién lo haga en la primera vuelta", agregó. El pasado fin de semana, un fallo de software provocó el caos en Sepang, donde los monoplazas redujeron la velocidad hasta casi detenerse en las dos vueltas de formación que se realizaron después de que los comisarios de carrera anularan la salida original debido a la fuerte lluvia. La FIA afirmó en un comunicado que hubo un "error humano" que dejó desactivado el modo de adelantamiento tras el periodo de bandera roja, antes de que se reactivara durante 27 segundos y se desactivara de nuevo. "La FIA reconoce que este desafortunado error humano afectó al rendimiento de determinados autos en función del momento de su vuelta y de su posición en la misma", señaló, añadiendo que el segundo y tercer periodos no se vieron afectados. Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, logró la pole position en la sesión de clasificación para la carrera al sprint del Gran Premio de Singapur, por delante del Mercedes de George Russell.

item.title: Ecobank to Join China’s CIPS Payments Platform for Yuan Settlement
item.description: By Duncan Miriri African lender Ecobank will sign an agreement to join the China Interbank Payments System for yuan transactions, its chief executive said, as banks race to capitalize on growing trade and investment ties between China and Africa. Demand for direct settlement of local …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Duncan Miriri

African lender Ecobank will sign an agreement to join the China Interbank Payments System for yuan transactions, its chief executive said, as banks race to capitalize on growing trade and investment ties between China and Africa.

Demand for direct settlement of local currencies into yuan has been rising across the continent as commerce with China expands and Beijing pushes to internationalize its currency, prompting banks to invest in the necessary payments infrastructure.

“CIPS is an important part of the infrastructure supporting international RMB payments,” Jeremy Awori told Reuters ahead of signing the deal in China on Saturday.

CIPS connects more than 5,000 banks in over 100 countries and territories, Awori said, providing businesses trading with China with more direct settlement options.

“This cooperation really strengthens the link between the Chinese RMB payment infrastructure and our African banking platform and payment infrastructure, which is obviously critical,” he said.

Ecobank, which operates in 34 African countries, is also in talks with Bank of China to jointly offer yuan settlement services and expects to make an announcement soon, Awori said.

The initiative would complement Ecobank’s CIPS participation and other payments partnerships aimed at facilitating trade between Africa and China.

While the dollar remains dominant in global trade and foreign exchange reserves, growing commercial ties with China have encouraged some African governments, companies and banks to increase their use of the yuan.

South Africa’s Standard Bank, which became the first African lender to connect to CIPS last November, secured authorization last month with Industrial and Commercial Bank of China to clear yuan transactions across the continent.

China-Africa trade rose nearly 18% last year, according to Chinese customs data, and Beijing removed tariffs on imports from 53 African nations on May 1.

Rwanda’s Bank of Kigali has become the latest African bank to join CIPS , while Banco de Fomento Angola (BFA) is also planning to join the platform.

item.title: Precios bonos Tesoro EEUU caen por alza del petróleo, inversores se centran en próximos datos de inflación
item.description: Los precios de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos caían el viernes, revirtiendo parte de las ganancias de inicios de semana, mientras el valor del petróleo se mantenía alto y los inversores aguardaban los próximos informes de inflación en busca de pistas sobre las medidas que tomará la Reserva Federal en su reunión de política monetaria del 27 y 28 de octubre.
item.dc:creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
item.content:encoded: Los precios de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos caían el viernes, revirtiendo parte de las ganancias de inicios de semana, mientras el valor del petróleo se mantenía alto y los inversores aguardaban los próximos informes de inflación en busca de pistas sobre las medidas que tomará la Reserva Federal en su reunión de política monetaria del 27 y 28 de octubre. "Estamos viendo cómo los precios del petróleo suben ligeramente a medida que avanza la sesión, y la preocupación mundial sigue siendo la misma: si los precios más altos de la energía van a mantenerse por más tiempo", dijo Chip Hughey, director general de renta fija de Truist Wealth. El crudo Brent subía un 0,7%, a 104,98 dólares por barril, mientras que los futuros estadounidenses ganaban un 0,6%, a 91,94 dólares. El rendimiento de referencia a 10 años avanzaba 2,8 puntos básicos, al 5,261%, tras alcanzar esta semana un máximo en 24 años. El retorno a 30 años se mantenía prácticamente sin cambios, en el 5,602%. Cuando los precios de los bonos del Tesoro caen, los rendimientos suben. "Nos estamos acercando al extremo superior del rango al que llegarán los rendimientos a 10 años a corto plazo, salvo que haya un recrudecimiento de la tensión en Oriente Medio", dijo Hughey, quien agregó que el mercado ha visto cómo los compradores han intervenido cuando el rendimiento a 10 años se ha acercado al rango del 5,30% al 5,35%. En el extremo más corto de la curva, la rentabilidad a dos años , que suele reflejar las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés, subía 5,2 puntos básicos, al 4,808%. La curva de rendimientos se aplanaba por segundo día consecutivo el viernes, y el diferencial entre los rendimientos a dos y 10 años se redujo de 46,7 a 45,3 puntos básicos. Los agentes en el mercado tienen la mirada puesta en los datos de inflación de la próxima semana. Los próximos informes del Índice de Precios al Consumidor y del Índice de Precios al Productor se publicarán el miércoles y el jueves, respectivamente.

item.title: FCC chief defers to Pentagon on airing US execution on TV networks
item.description: The chair of the Federal Communications Commission said on Friday that he would defer to the Pentagon on whether US networks could air a planned December 3 military execution, which would be an unprecedented broadcast.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The chair of the Federal Communications Commission said on Friday that he would defer to the Pentagon on whether US networks could air a planned December 3 military execution, which would be an unprecedented broadcast. US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Thursday that the execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist convicted of killing 13 people and wounding 32 others at the Fort Hood military base in Texas in 2009, would be livestreamed. Carr told CNBC it was his understanding this would not air on broadcast TV. But asked if he would allow it to be aired, he said: "Ultimately we're going to defer to Secretary Hegseth and you know his decisions on how to move forward with this." An FCC spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment. ABC, NBC, CBS and Fox did not immediately respond to requests for comment on whether they are considering airing the execution. Andrew Jay Schwartzman, a senior counselor at the Benton Institute for Broadband & Society and expert on FCC issues, said there is no legal basis for the commission to intervene in a broadcaster's decision on whether to air a live execution. "There is absolutely no justification in the Communications Act or the Constitution that would allow the FCC to tell broadcasters to carry or not carry an actual event," he said, adding, "there is no basis for the FCC to dictate content or to prohibit content short of obscenity." A 2007 report from the FCC on violence on television said the agency did not have the authority to regulate violent content. The report said "violent speech and depictions of violence have been found by the courts to be protected by the First Amendment."

item.title: Economía peruana habría crecido en agosto a nivel similar del 3,5% de julio: banco central
item.description: La economía peruana habría crecido en agosto a niveles "muy similares" a los de julio, cuando avanzó un 3,56% interanual, dijo el viernes el gerente de política monetaria del banco central, pese a los efectos adversos del fenómeno climático de El Niño.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La economía peruana habría crecido en agosto a niveles "muy similares" a los de julio, cuando avanzó un 3,56% interanual, dijo el viernes el gerente de política monetaria del banco central, pese a los efectos adversos del fenómeno climático de El Niño. El crecimiento de julio [USN:L1N4570M5 TEXT:"superó las expectativas"] de los analistas debido al buen desempeño ese mes de casi todos los sectores productivos del tercer mayor productor mundial de cobre. Carlos Montoro, en una conferencia telefónica, afirmó que los afectos de El Niño ha tenido repercusiones en sectores como la pesca, la agricultura y la industria textil, aunque los sectores no primarios están creciendo a un ritmo del 5%. "Lo que se estima es que el dinamismo en el mes de agosto va a ser muy similar al que hemos visto en el mes de julio, que se observa principalmente una contribución en la actividad económica asociada al PIB no primario (...) pero vemos números muy similares", manifestó el funcionario La cifra de evolución del PIB de agosto la difundirá la oficina de estadística (INEI) el miércoles 15 de octubre. El gobierno de la presidenta Keiko Fujimori proyectó recientemente que la economía cerraría el año con una expansión del 3,4%, debido al impulso de la demanda interna y mayor inversión publica y privada. "Nosotros estamos viendo que el impacto climático va a durar hasta el primer semestre del próximo año y para el segundo semestre ya deberíamos comenzar a ver una mejora en estos sectores", dijo Montoro en referencia al agro y la pesca. El miércoles, mientras analistas preveían un alza de la tasa de interés, la autoridad monetaria mantuvo el costo del financiamiento en 4,25%, nivel en que se ha mantenido estable desde septiembre de 2025, tras una serie de recortes previos. Perú registró una inflación del 1,5% el año pasado, una de las más bajas de la región, y el banco central prevé que alcance el 4,2% este año, según una reciente proyección.

Polish police seek to reassure schools after rumours of more attacks

09 October, 2026 11:00 pm IST

By Pawel Florkiewicz and Alicja Surdy WARSAW, Oct 9 (Reuters) – Thousands of Polish police officers visited schools nationwide to try to reassure pupils after two stabbing sprees by teenagers in as many days sparked rumours of a “Bloody Friday” of more attacks stemming from a supposed online challenge.

Polish Deputy Prime Minister Krzysztof Gawkowski said there was no confirmed evidence that the school attacks were part of a coordinated operation or linked to an online challenge.

By early evening, police officers had checked almost 35,000 schools and detained 59 people, police said on X.

Show Full Article

“There will be no compromise here — the safety of youngsters is the most important thing,” Interior Minister Marcin Kierwinski told a press conference.

Education Minister Barbara Nowacka said 59 schools were closed, mainly in the Mazowsze region where the attacks took place.

TWO ATTACKS IN TWO DAYS

On Thursday, a 15-year-old former pupil wearing a helmet-mounted camera killed a caretaker and injured two teachers at a primary school in Leszczydol-Nowiny, northeast of Warsaw. On Wednesday, a 19-year-old wounded 10 people including himself at another school in Ostroleka, north of the capital.

The scale of the police deployment and the school closures underscored the shock in a country where such incidents have been very rare, and the speed with which online rumours have amplified the fear.

In Warsaw, 59-year-old NGO manager and mother-of-four Dorota Czekaj told Reuters the week’s events had left her “simply terrified”. She called for a tough response to any online content that could encourage violence.

The authorities also warned people of the risks of online disinformation. Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz suggested Russia could use such events to sow panic.

Russia has repeatedly denied attempting to destabilise Western countries using online disinformation.

POLICE ARREST TEENS

Polish police made a string of arrests on Friday.

These included a 13-year-old from Warsaw who posted a photo of a knife in a class group chat and threatened other students, a 14-year-old in Warsaw detained on school grounds with a knife and firecrackers, and two 15-year-olds from Pruszkow County, just outside the capital, who posted a video with threats to kill.

Several social media accounts posted pictures on Thursday of a TikTok account which purported to belong to the attacker from Leszczydol-Nowiny and featured images taken just before the incident. Reuters was unable to find the account, which appeared to have been taken down.

The Central Bureau for Combating Cybercrime said it was aware of the content and that the platform was cooperating with the agency. TikTok did not reply to an emailed request for comment.

(Reporting by Pawel Florkiewicz, Alicja Surdy, Kuba Stezycki; Additional reporting by Anna Koper; Writing by Alan Charlish;Editing by Gareth Jones and Alison williams)

item.title: トランプ氏、ロシアがディーゼル供給で合意 30万トン超即時供給へ
item.description: [ワシントン／モスクワ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン／モスクワ ９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は９日、ロシアのプーチン大統領との「極めて成功した」協議の結果、ロシアが米国と世界市場向けにディーゼル（軽油）３０万トン超を直ちに供給することで合意したと述べた。

トランプ氏によると、ロシアは製油所の稼働状況に応じ、その後に短期間のうちに合計３００万トンのディーゼル燃料を供給。１１月に５０万トンを直ちに供給し、その後さらに１００万トンを速やかに供給するという。

これに先立ちトランプ氏は、ホワイトハウスでのイベントで「ディーゼルに関して間もなく大きな発表がある」とし、「われわれはこの問題を徹底的に解決するつもりだ」と述べていた。

プーチン大統領のドミトリエフ特使もＸへの投稿で、プーチン大統領がトランプ大統領と行った電話会談でディーゼル供給に関し合意したとし、「ディーゼルとエネルギーに関するロシアと米国の協力は世界に利益をもたらすだろう」と述べた。

これに関連して複数の業界関係筋は、トランプ氏は一部の省庁トップに対し、ディーゼル価格の抑制策を検討するよう近く指示を出す可能性があるとの見方を示していた。トランプ氏は大統領覚書などの形で、エネルギー生産を妨げている州・地方レベルの規制を回避する方策の検討を関係当局に求めるほか、冷戦時代に制定された国防生産法（ＤＰＡ）を活用して原油や燃料の生産拡大を促す可能性があるとしていた。

米国とイスラエルによるイランへの攻撃が始まって以来、ディーゼル価格は約７０％急騰し、１１月３日の米中間選挙まで約１カ月となる中、米国のディーゼル価格は過去最高値近辺を推移している。

item.title: トランプ氏、銃殺刑執行ライブ配信計画に沈黙 共和党議員から批判も
item.description:
Bo Erickson Gram Slattery
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Gram Slattery

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は、２００９年に南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で１３人を殺害した銃撃犯の死刑執行をライブ配信するという前例のない措置について沈黙を保っている。

米国防総省は、同陸軍基地で銃を乱射し１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚について、１２月３日に予定されている軍による銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信すると明らかにした。銃殺刑は１９４５年以来初めてとなる。

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスで９日に開かれたイベントで、ハサン死刑囚が銃殺刑に処されると述べたものの、ヘグセス国防長官が８日に発表した（死刑執行を中継する）計画についてはコメントしなかった。

ホワイトハウスは、関連する全ての質問を国防総省に委ねている。

今回の決定を巡っては、一部の共和党議員からも批判の声が上がっている。共和党のトム・ティリス上院議員（ノースカロライナ州選出）は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で、この計画を「嫌悪感を超えるものだ」と非難。「公開処刑はイランやアフガニスタンのような抑圧的な独裁政権が行うことだ」とし、「米国でそんなことがあってはならない」と述べた。

item.title: UN calls US plans to livestream execution 'abhorrent'
item.description: The United Nations on Friday called US plans to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the gunman who killed 13 people at the Fort Hood military base in 2009, "abhorrent" and said it could be a violation of prohibitions against torture.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United Nations on Friday called US plans to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the gunman who killed 13 people at the Fort Hood military base in 2009, "abhorrent" and said it could be a violation of prohibitions against torture. "These kinds of public executions we've seen in other countries, whether it's Iran or Afghanistan ... can constitute a form of cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment, or punishment," UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric told a daily UN briefing in New York. "Showing it live is tantamount ... to it being public, and could be a violation of the prohibition against torture," he said. "A government executing someone in public, or in front of live cameras, frankly, is abhorrent." Hasan is set to become the first person to be executed by US military firing squad since 1945. The execution is scheduled for December 3 at the same sprawling Texas base where Hasan opened fire with a handgun in a medical facility.

item.title: De SpaceX a los Lakers: cómo Josh Kushner amasó una fortuna US$17.500 millones
item.description: El fundador de Thrive Capital participa en la apuesta por SpaceX y en la compra de los Lakers por US$12.500 millones, mientras expande sus inversiones en IA y busca nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
item.dc:creator: Natasha Mascarenhas, Tom Maloney
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Desde la salida a bolsa de SpaceX ( SPCX ) hasta la adquisición récord de los Lakers de Los Ángeles, y el acuerdo con la FIFA que fracasó en cuestión de días, Josh Kushner se ha visto involucrado en algunas de las operaciones más sonadas de este año. Con 41 años, actualmente dirige Thrive Capital, la empresa de capital riesgo que fundó hace 16 años, y la está convirtiendo, más allá de su actividad inicial de financiación de startups y compañías privadas en fase de crecimiento, en un inversor en los mercados públicos y en propietario a largo plazo de activos emblemáticos de gran prestigio. Ver más: Cómo surgió el polémico plan de la FIFA para vender parte de su negocio Estas iniciativas dificultarán que Kushner mantenga el perfil discreto que ha cultivado durante tanto tiempo. Ya ha logrado acumular una fortuna que, según el Índice de Multimillonarios de Bloomberg, asciende a unos US$17.500 millones, lo que le sitúa por primera vez entre las 500 personas más ricas del mundo. Durante los últimos meses, Thrive ha invertido en compañías como Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) y Shopify Inc. ( SHOP ). Su nueva estrategia, Thrive Holdings, ha recaudado más de US$2.000 millones para adquirir y gestionar negocios poco atractivos, como despachos de contabilidad y empresas de servicios de tecnología de la información, que pretende transformar mediante la inteligencia artificial. Otra de sus iniciativas, Thrive Eternal, se centra en activos que considera a prueba de la inteligencia artificial y está contribuyendo a financiar la compra de los Lakers por un importe de US$12.500 millones. “Nunca hemos creído que los límites tradicionales de nuestro sector deban definirnos”, escribió Kushner a sus inversionistas en agosto. Un portavoz de Kushner se negó a comentar la valoración que Bloomberg ha realizado de su patrimonio neto. Entre las mayores inversiones de Thrive en compañías privadas se encuentra OpenAI, la empresa creadora de ChatGPT, dirigida por Sam Altman, que ha revolucionado todo el sector de la IA. Thrive invirtió por primera vez en la compañía en 2023 y, posteriormente, ha realizado inversiones a través de varios fondos. Una salida a bolsa, prevista para el 2027, podría suponer una enorme ganancia inesperada para sus inversores. Thrive, además, es inversora en otras empresas que podrían salir a bolsa, como la fintech Stripe y la compañía de defensa Anduril. Uno de los catalizadores de la expansión de Thrive en 2026 ha sido la salida a bolsa de SpaceX en junio, valorada en US$1,77 billones. Thrive invirtió por primera vez en la compañía espacial de Elon Musk con una valoración de US$38.000 millones. Asimismo, respaldó a la empresa de programación de inteligencia artifcial Cursor con una valoración de US$9.900 millones, catorce meses antes de que SpaceX la adquiriera por US$60.000 millones de dólares. La firma invirtió por primera vez en Cursor con una valoración de US$400 millones. Ver más: UEFA evalúa denunciar penalmente a Infantino y busca citar a Kushner por su plan de inversión Esos éxitos han permitido a Thrive diversificarse en tres estrategias distintas. En agosto, Thrive Holdings recaudó fondos de inversionistas como SoftBank Group Corp., Altimeter Capital Management y D1 Capital, lo que situó su valoración en US$12.000 millones. Ha adquirido más de 70 empresas y cuenta con un equipo especializado de 35 personas, según la carta a los inversores de Kushner. Thrive Eternal, por su parte, se centra en “activos arraigados en la identidad, la cultura, la comunidad, la historia y la experiencia física”, que, en su opinión, están llamados a adquirir mayor valor en la era de la inteligencia artificial. Thrive Eternal se introdujo discretamente en el mundo del deporte en abril, al adquirir una participación minoritaria en el equipo de béisbol de los San Francisco Giants. Dos meses más tarde, Kushner e Iger estaban estudiando la posibilidad de presentar una oferta por una franquicia de expansión de la NBA (Asociación Nacional de Baloncesto) en Las Vegas. No obstante, después de que el propietario de los Lakers, Mark Walter, se viera envuelto en una investigación federal sobre sus empresas, hubo un giro hacia esa histórica franquicia y cerraron el acuerdo en tan solo un día. Iger, de 75 años, que tiene previsto abandonar el consejo de administración de Disney ( DIS ) a finales de año, declaró en una entrevista anterior con Bloomberg News que se reincorporó a Kushner como asesor tras recibir una propuesta sobre Thrive Eternal. “Lo que pensé que iba a ser un proceso de incorporación más lento se ha acelerado de repente de forma significativa”, afirmó Iger. A pesar de las llamativas operaciones en el ámbito deportivo, la mayor parte del patrimonio neto de Kushner está vinculada a Thrive, que ahora gestiona más de US$65.000 millones, frente a los aproximadamente US$15.000 millones de hace tres años. En aquel momento, un grupo formado por Mukesh Ambani, Jorge Lemann y Henry Kravis invirtió con una valoración de US$5.300 millones. Aquella valoración, que representaba casi un tercio de los activos gestionados, llamó la atención. Sin embargo, el rápido crecimiento de Thrive y su racha de inversiones exitosas parecen haber justificado esa cifra. Más del 50% de sus activos gestionados proceden ahora de plusvalías de inversión, según indica la carta de Kushner a los inversores. Ver más: SpaceX adquiere espectro de banda baja para convertir a Starlink en operador móvil Bloomberg calcula que Thrive ha generado más de US$6.000 millones en intereses de gestión desde su fundación, la mayor parte de los cuales se han obtenido en los últimos tres años. Aunque gran parte de esa cantidad sigue sin materializarse, Thrive generó “más de US$1.000 millones de liquidez” en los últimos 12 meses y prevé la posibilidad de obtener miles de millones más en los próximos trimestres, según la carta de Kushner de 2026. Thrive busca ahora una inversión minoritaria de “de magnitud similar” por parte de su grupo de accionistas original y de algunos nuevos socios, según ha indicado la propia empresa. Basándose en el crecimiento de sus activos desde la última ronda de captación de fondos, Bloomberg calcula que la empresa tiene ahora un valor aproximado de US$23.000 millones. Sin duda, no todo ha salido como Kushner esperaba este año. A finales de julio, la FIFA (Federación Internacional de Fútbol Asociación), el organismo rector del fútbol, pretendía recaudar hasta US$4.200 milloness para una división comercial, abriéndose por primera vez a la inversión externa. Se esperaba que Thrive Eternal encabezara el grupo de inversionistas. No obstante, el plan recibió una acogida hostil por parte de varias federaciones regionales de fútbol y fracasó tan solo unos días después de su anuncio. La UEFA (Unión de Asociaciones Europeas de Fútbol), el organismo rector del fútbol europeo, solicitó a un juez federal que autorizara citaciones para obtener documentos y el testimonio de Kushner y Thrive, mientras estudia posibles acciones legales en relación con la gestión de la transacción por parte de la FIFA. “Todos los implicados en este asunto han salido algo malparados”, afirmó Marc Ganis, consultor deportivo. El mes pasado, Kushner afirmó que Thrive “no supo valorar la dinámica política del fútbol mundial”. La UEFA no ha acusado a Thrive ni a Kushner de ninguna irregularidad. El acuerdo de los Lakers también se ha enfrentado a la oposición de los aficionados porque Kushner, nacido y criado en Nueva Jersey, construyó Thrive principalmente desde Nueva York, con vínculos limitados con Los Ángeles. Esa brecha se ha subsanado en parte gracias a las profundas relaciones de Iger en toda la ciudad y con la NBA. Ver más: La NBA respalda su expansión a Seattle y Las Vegas: prevé US$10.000 millones por franquicia Luego está la cuestión del dinero. Con un valor de US$12.500 millones, el acuerdo valora a los Lakers un 25% por encima de lo que Walter pagó menos de un año antes, lo que ya supuso un récord que eclipsó la venta de los Boston Celtics por US$6.100 millones. Kushner está invirtiendo junto con Thrive Eternal para ayudar a financiar la compra. Todo esto fue posible únicamente después de que la NBA modificara el mes pasado su política sobre el capital de riesgo para permitir que las entidades de inversión institucionales realizaran inversiones junto con sus gestores. Con anterioridad, estos acuerdos estaban prohibidos para evitar la apariencia de un conflicto de intereses. “Se trataba de una operación importante para la NBA”, afirmó Ganis. El cambio de política formaba parte de una revisión en curso de las normas de la NBA, pero se aceleró a raíz de la transacción de los Lakers, según una persona con conocimiento del asunto que solicitó permanecer en el anonimato. En las previsiones distribuidas entre los posibles inversores, Thrive prevé aumentar los ingresos del equipo hasta unos US$600 millones ddurante la próxima década, frente a los US$129 millones de la temporada pasada. Entre las opciones se incluyen vender más entradas para partidos sueltos y menos abonos de temporada, buscar más patrocinios y construir un nuevo pabellón. Thrive y Kushner llevan mucho tiempo intentando “no restar protagonismo a los fundadores con los que colaboramos”, según un portavoz. Kushner lo ha conseguido en gran medida a pesar de la notoriedad de su hermano mayor, Jared, que está casado con Ivanka Trump y ha ocupado cargos en las dos administraciones del presidente Donald Trump. Un papel protagonista en una de las franquicias deportivas más famosas del mundo hará que sea más difícil eludir ese protagonismo. Con la colaboración de Randall Williams. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Mike Ditka, Hall of Fame player and Bears coach, dies at 86
item.description: Mike Ditka, a Pro Football Hall of Fame tight end best known as the slick-haired and mustachioed head coach who led the NFL's Chicago Bears to their only Super Bowl triumph in 1986, has died. He was 86.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mike Ditka, a Pro Football Hall of Fame tight end best known as the slick-haired and mustachioed head coach who led the NFL's Chicago Bears to their only Super Bowl triumph in 1986, has died. He was 86. Ditka's death was announced in a statement by his family on Friday. No cause of death was given. "It is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of our beloved husband, father, grandfather, and friend," Ditka's family said in a statement. "While the world knew Mike as a Hall of Fame football player, legendary coach, and leader of the Chicago Bears’ Super Bowl XX championship team, we knew him as the heart of our family. "Mike will be missed beyond measure and remembered forever." Revered in Chicago and famous nationwide as "Da Coach," Ditka was a blunt, straight-talking legend with a devoted following and restaurants bearing his name. He also sold a number of products with his name on, including cigars, sausages and wine. TRANSFORMED THE TIGHT END POSITION As a player, Ditka revolutionized the tight end position and was a five-time Pro Bowl selection while playing with the Bears from 1961-66 before moving on to the Philadelphia Eagles and then the Dallas Cowboys, where he featured in the team's Super Bowl triumph in January 1972. Selected fifth overall by the Bears in the 1961 NFL Draft, Ditka introduced a new dimension to the tight end position that once was viewed primarily as an assignment for a tough, talented blocker. While Ditka, also affectionately known as "Iron Mike," was a superior blocker, he became one of the first tight ends to catch a large number of passes. He earned Rookie of the Year honors after becoming the first tight end in NFL history to record 1,000 receiving yards in a season and went on to win the 1963 NFL championship with Chicago prior to the start of the Super Bowl era. At the time of his retirement after the 1972 season, Ditka ranked second among all tight ends in receptions, according to the Pro Football Hall of Fame. He is also the only individual in the NFL's modern era to win a league title with the same team as a player and head coach. "Mike's impact on the Chicago Bears organization, over decades as a player, coach and proud icon and ambassador for our organization is immeasurable," the team said in a statement. "His integral role in bringing world championships to our city and our franchise, both as a player and as our coach, established prominence and excellence at a world-class level, but also created a lifetime of cherished memories in the hearts and minds of Bears fans that will last for generations." DITKA 'EPITOMIZED FOOTBALL' Following his playing career Ditka became a member of Tom Landry's coaching staff in Dallas where he won a Super Bowl. He eventually returned to Chicago as head coach and turned the Bears into one of the league's most dominant champions. The Bears team that Ditka led to Super Bowl glory featured one of the most vaunted defenses in NFL history and a top-ranked offense. With the likes of Walter Payton, William "The Refrigerator" Perry, Jim McMahon and Mike Singletary, the Bears transcended professional sports and became a global pop culture phenomenon after recording “The Super Bowl Shuffle” rap song and accompanying music video that became an unlikely hit. The song was released weeks before the Bears beat the New England Patriots 46-10 in the Super Bowl. At the time, it was the largest margin of victory in any Super Bowl. After the game, the Chicago players carried Ditka, who was wearing a sleeveless Bears sweater over a formal dress shirt and tie, off the field on their shoulders. "Mike Ditka epitomized football over so many years. He brought intensity, authenticity and an unmistakable personality to everything he did," NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell said in a statement. "As a Hall of Fame player, Super Bowl-winning coach with his beloved and iconic Bears, and as a broadcaster, Mike served as an ambassador for the game and inspired generations of fans."

item.title: 独メルツ氏、シュレーダー元首相に「憤り」 プーチン大統領の誕生会出席に
item.description:
Emanuele Berro Friederike Heine
[９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Emanuele Berro　Friederike Heine

[９日　ロイター] - ドイツ政府の報道官は９日、シュレーダー元首相がロシアのプーチン大統領の誕生日を祝うために自宅を訪問したことに対し、メルツ首相が「深い憤り」を抱いていると明らかにした。誕生会への出席は「完全に倫理に反すると見ている」と説明した。

報道官は「ウクライナ侵攻の責任はプーチン氏にある。命令によって計り知れない苦しみや民間人の犠牲、家族の分断、死傷者を生み出した」と強調した。南ドイツ新聞によると、シュレーダー氏が所属する社会民主党（ＳＰＤ）の共同党首で、連立政権の財務相を務めるクリングバイル氏も、誕生日を祝うための訪問は「全く容認できない」と述べた。

１９９８年から２００５年まで首相を務めたシュレーダー氏はロシアの経済界やプーチン氏と深いつながりがあるとして、ドイツ国内外から批判を浴びている。過去２０年間、石油会社ロスネフチなどロシア企業で複数の要職に就任。先週には、ロシアの小売企業の監査役会に加わった。

プーチン氏は以前、ロシアの欧州との安全保障対話の相手としてシュレーダー氏が望ましいとの見解を示したものの、欧州連合（ＥＵ）とメルツ政権は即座にこれを拒否している。

item.title: UAE says Omani flydubai co-pilot planned suicide attack on Tel Aviv flight
item.description: An Omani flydubai co-pilot had intended to seize a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight and crash it into a terminal at Israel's Ben Gurion Airport on September 30 in a suicide attack before he was thwarted by the captain, the UAE attorney general said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Yasmine Ghania, Enas Alashray, Federico Maccioni
item.content:encoded: An Omani flydubai co-pilot had intended to [USN:L1N45M07P TEXT:"seize a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight"] and crash it into a terminal at Israel's Ben Gurion Airport on September 30 in a suicide attack before he was thwarted by the captain, the UAE attorney general said on Friday. Attorney General Hamad Saif al Shamsi's statement did not appear to implicate flydubai in any wrongdoing, and contained the most detailed account yet from prosecutors about what they believe to have happened. Flydubai was not immediately available for comment. The plan was inspired by the September 11, 2001, attacks on the US, UAE public prosecutors think, as a result of their criminal investigation launched on October 1. It found the suspect had used two previous flights to Tel Aviv to "familiarise himself with the flight route and the airport", the state news agency WAM reported. It is the first public confirmation of the co-pilot's 9/11 inspiration. The aircraft was in Saudi airspace when the co-pilot attacked the captain with a crash axe, typically kept in the cockpit for use during emergencies. The incident caused the airliner to [USN:L4N45Q00M TEXT:"plunge"] 16,000 feet (4,900 meters) in 30 seconds before the attacker was overwhelmed and two other pilots who were on board landed the aircraft safely in Saudi Arabia. The suspect was transferred to the UAE, flydubai's home country. SUSPECT MET PROFESSIONAL AND SECURITY REQUIREMENTS Investigators examined flydubai's recruiting procedures and found the suspect had met all professional and security requirements, including holding a pilot's licence and providing a certificate of good conduct. "However, none of the procedures revealed any indications of his extremist views or his intention to carry out a terrorist plot," Al Shamsi added. He said the 29-year-old had worked for airlines in different countries including Oman Air before joining flydubai in January 2026. The investigation found there were signs of the suspect drifting towards "extremism and terrorism" as early as 2017, while he was studying in Australia. Royal Air Maroc has said that he underwent three months of training there in 2025, but that his application to work for the airline afterwards was rejected. UAE officials have not identified the suspect; however, a person with direct knowledge of the matter told Reuters he had been identified as [USN:L1N45P01E TEXT:"Hammam al-Hammami"], an Omani national. Al Shamsi said the suspect had told investigators he had prepared psychologically and physically for the attack by viewing material promoting terrorism and taking boxing lessons. Saudi Arabia has launched a [USN:L1N45S12C TEXT:"separate safety investigation"] into flight FZ1073, sources told Reuters.

item.title: Vance says he won't watch livestream of execution; Trump remains silent
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance said on Friday that he would not watch a livestream of the military execution of the gunman who killed 13 people at Fort Hood military base in 2009, while President Donald Trump has yet to comment on the Pentagon plan.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: US Vice President JD Vance said on Friday that he would not watch a livestream of the military execution of the gunman who killed 13 people at Fort Hood military base in 2009, while President Donald Trump has yet to comment on the Pentagon plan. "I don't know that that's actually going to happen," Vance told reporters while campaigning in Ohio. "If it's ultimately livestreamed, I'm not going to be watching it." Trump said at a White House event on Friday that former Army psychiatrist Nidal Hasan would be executed by firing squad. But he has not commented on the livestream plan announced by Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on Thursday that has drawn [USN:FWN45V0WT TEXT:"criticism at home and abroad"]. Some Republican lawmakers and conservative strategists have criticized the decision. Republican US Senator Thom Tillis of North Carolina called the idea "beyond disgusting" in a social media post. "Public executions are what oppressive dictatorships like Iran and Afghanistan do," said the senator, a frequent Trump critic who is not running for reelection. "It should not be happening in America." Hasan is set to become the first person to be executed by US military firing squad since 1945. The execution is scheduled for December 3 at the same sprawling Texas base where Hasan opened fire with a handgun in a medical facility.

item.title: 日英欧加外相、ＩＣＣへの支持表明 米制裁受け共同声明
item.description: [ベルリン ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ベルリン ９日 ロイター] - 日本や英国、複数の欧州諸国、カナダの外相は９日、トランプ米政権が国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁措置を科したことを受けて共同声明を発表し、ＩＣＣに対する揺るぎない支持を表明した。

日英のほか、ドイツ、フランス、イタリア、デンマーク、オランダ、カナダの外相らは「制裁が実施されれば、ＩＣＣの活動、献身的な職員、その家族に重大な影響を及ぼすことになる」とし、「彼らは最も重大な国際犯罪で告発された者たちを法の下で裁き、被害者を支援するために尽力している」とした。

item.title: 米家計の所得・資産増加、債務ストレス拡大も＝22─25年のＦＲＢ調査
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が９日公表した、２０２...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米家計の所得・資産増加、債務ストレス拡大も＝22─25年のＦＲＢ調査 1:26 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）ビル。2025年9月撮影。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno

Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が９日公表した、２０２２年から２５年の消費者金融調査によると、新型コロナウイルス禍からの脱却に伴い、米国の多くの家計で所得と資産が増加したことが明らかになった。所得の伸びは低所得層に集中する一方、高インフレ期の債務負担の増加により、経済的ストレスを抱える家計の割合も拡大した。

ＦＲＢが３年に一度実施する同調査は、「緩やかな景気拡大とインフレ高止まりを背景に、多くの家計で所得と純資産が緩やかに増加した一方、経済的ストレスを抱えている家計の割合が拡大しているとみられる」と指摘。所得に対する債務返済比率が４０％以上の家計の割合は８．６％と６．５％から上昇し、２０１３年以来の高水準となった。

インフレ調整後の家計所得中央値は、同調査対象期間に７％増加し、８万２２００ドルとなった。これは、コロナ禍で逼迫していた労働市場が徐々に緩和され、失業率が小幅に上昇した時期にあたる。また、最も大きな所得の伸びが見られたのは所得分布の下位層で、特にサービス業で人手不足が深刻となり、企業が人材の確保・維持に向けて賃上げやボーナスを提供していたコロナ禍後の状況と整合した。

実質純資産の中央値は２％増の２１万５９００ドル。ＦＲＢは「純資産および所得分布を問わず、ほとんどの家計で増加がみられた」と説明した。

住宅所有率は約６６％で横ばいだった一方、株式市場への参加率は２２年の５８％から２５年には５６％へと小幅低下した。

所得格差はわずかに縮小し、全体として資産が広範に増加した一方、黒人世帯や低所得世帯の純資産は減少した。資産下位４分の１に属する世帯の純資産は３８００ドルから１７００ドルへと減少した一方、非ヒスパニック系黒人世帯は、平均純資産が約５％増加したにもかかわらず、純資産の中央値は２５％と大幅に落ち込んだ。ＦＲＢによると、この傾向は１３年以降続いてきた増加基調を反転させるものだという。

今回の調査は４３６７世帯を対象に、主に２５年４月から１２月にかけて実施された。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も 最終更新: 10/10(土) 1:26 ロイター

FAST

DOHA, Oct 9 : US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will skip next week's annual meetings of the IMF and World Bank in Bangkok, Thailand, due to domestic engagements, a US official said on Friday.  The Treasury Department confirmed that Deputy Treasury Secretary Francis Brooke and Under Secretary for International Affairs Erin Browne will lead the US delegation for the department, with many pressing economic issues on the agenda.  Treasury said US officials would work with partners at the meetings to address policies and structural imbalances that have held back growth, while pushing for "more transparency and more effective approaches to sovereign debt." Bessent's absence from the high-profile financial event comes at a critical moment when benchmark Treasury yields have surged to their highest levels in nearly 25 years and the ongoing energy shock caused by the war in the Middle East has set back global growth.

It was not immediately clear what domestic engagements are keeping Bessent at home, but he has been a key spokesman for domestic economic policies as the midterm US elections approach. The US  also leads the Group of 20 major economies this year, and the Treasury chief would normally have chaired a meeting of finance ministers and central bankers from around the world. Bessent is expected to attend the G20 leaders summit in Miami, Florida, in December. It is not unprecedented for top officials to miss occasional meetings due to scheduling issues or other factors, but Bessent's decision may frustrate top officials from other countries, who generally use the meetings to secure formal and informal bilateral meetings with their US counterpart. Bessent skipped the G20 meetings in South Africa last year amid the Trump administration's objections to the country's land reforms and other issues. Treasury said the US delegation would focus on the debt issues so that countries facing debt distress could restore stability and return to growth, while creditors and borrowers are "held to clear and consistent standards." The US would also continue to press the International Monetary Fund and World Bank — where it is the biggest shareholder — to focus on their core mandates, operate efficiently, and support policies that promote economic stability, productivity and growth. "Our engagement in Bangkok will be guided by a clear objective: ensuring that the international financial institutions and the broader international economic system advance US economic and national security interests," Treasury said in a statement.

Source: Reuters

item.title: トランプ氏、ＦＲＢクック理事巡る調査委設置 解任理由の有無検証
item.description: [ワシントン ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事について、住宅ローンに関連して虚偽の説明を行った疑惑を調査する委員会を設置した。ホワイトハウスのウェブサイトに９日に掲載された通知で明らかになった。

通知は７日付で、「私が責務を遂行するのを支援するため、委員会はクック理事に対する疑惑を調査し、クック理事の解任に足る『理由（cause）』があるかどうかを私に報告する」としている。

委員会はクック理事に対する証拠と疑惑を検証するため、ホワイトハウスで対面による公聴会を開く。公聴会の所要時間は４時間を超えないとしている。

クック氏の弁護士は「提案されている手続きが真に公正なものとなる可能性があるのか、それとも単なる形式的な手続きに過ぎないのかを見極めるため、ホワイトハウスと協議してきた」とし、ホワイトハウスで開かれる公聴会が「少しでも客観的なら」、クック理事が住宅ローンに関する不正行為を行っていないことが示され、解任する根拠はないことが明らかになると指摘。「クック理事は自身の潔白を証明し、解任の法的根拠が存在しないことを示す機会を歓迎している」とした。

ANKARA, Oct 9 : Turkey have sacked national soccer coach Vincenzo Montella, the Turkish Football Federation (TFF) said on Friday. The federation said in a statement that its executive board had decided not to continue with the Italian coach, without giving a reason for the decision or naming a replacement. Montella, who took charge of Turkey in September 2023, led the team to the quarter-finals of the 2024 European Championship. The decision follows four consecutive defeats in the UEFA Nations League, including a 3-1 loss to Italy on Tuesday. Turkey were also eliminated in the group stage of the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Trump says Russia to supply diesel to US and global market
item.description: President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel to the US and global marketplace in an effort aimed at cutting prices for the fuel ahead of the November midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel to the US and global marketplace in an effort aimed at cutting prices for the fuel ahead of the November midterm elections. The move comes as prices of diesel, used in agriculture, heating homes and trucking goods, are near record highs ahead of the November 3 congressional elections that will determine control of Congress. Trump said in a post on social media he had a "highly successful" discussion with President Vladimir Putin in which they agreed that Russia will immediately supply the diesel. An envoy for Putin, Kirill Dmitriev, praised cooperation between Russia and the United States on diesel and energy in a post on X on Friday, shortly after the call. Trump said Russia would supply another 500,000 tons in November, and another 1,000,000 tons "immediately thereafter." Even more would come after that, Trump said, "based on the condition of their diesel refineries" which have been damaged by attacks during Russia's war on Ukraine. The unusual move comes as the US has imposed sanctions on Russia's energy companies over its war on Ukraine that began in February, 2022. The Treasury Department issued a general license on Friday allowing importation of Russian diesel until April 7 next year. [USN:L1N45U0FQ TEXT:"Diesel prices"], which can drive inflation, are up 70% since the US-Israeli war with Iran began this year, despite two high-profile recent moves by Trump to boost supplies of the fuel: pressuring allies to release emergency reserves and expanding access to tax-exempt red-dyed diesel, which is normally used for farm equipment. The wars in Iran and Ukraine have triggered an unprecedented global fuel supply crunch, pushing average US diesel prices to $6.28 a gallon on Thursday, according to the AAA motorist organization. "Lower prices for Americans, especially our Great Farmers, Ranchers, and Truckers, is my Greatest Priority," Trump said. DEFENSE PRODUCTION ACT Three industry sources said earlier on Friday that Trump will issue a directive in coming days to some US department heads to find ways to control prices of diesel. The directive, which they said could take the form of a presidential memo, will push officials to find ways to bypass local and state regulations blocking energy production and use the Cold War-era Defense Production Act (DPA) to increase output of oil and fuel. Under the DPA, the president has authorities allowing loans, or loan guarantees to expand domestic manufacturing of critical materials and to require companies to prioritize government contracts for essential goods. The White House has been weighing how to use the DPA to expand refining capacity as the war with Iran exposes a US vulnerability to supply disruptions and price spikes. Refining executives [USN:L1N45214P TEXT:"told administration officials"] last month that federal money would be better directed toward making refineries more efficient or expanding existing plants rather than financing an entirely new refinery, which would be considerably more costly and take years to complete. Trump also said he expected gasoline prices to fall soon to levels around $1.85 to $1.95, well below Friday's average price of about $4.37 a gallon, according to AAA.

item.title: ＥＵ、ＩＣＣ機能維持へ必要措置講じる用意 米制裁巡り

item.dc:creator: ロイター

[ブリュッセル ９日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）の欧州委員会は９日の声明で、米国による制裁発動後も、国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）が活動を継続できるよう必要なあらゆる措置を講じる用意があると表明した。

米トランプ政権は９日、国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁を科した。

これに対し欧州委員会は、極めて遺憾だとの見解を表明。ただ、制裁の適用までに６カ月の猶予があるため、対話の余地は残されているとの見方も示した。

item.title: CAF reviewing decision to play Africa Cup of Nations every four years
item.description: Confederation of African Football (CAF) President Patrice Motsepe said the organisation was discussing reverting to hosting the Africa Cup of Nations every two years.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Confederation of African Football (CAF) President Patrice Motsepe said the organisation was discussing reverting to hosting the Africa Cup of Nations every two years. Motsepe made the remarks at a CAF strategy conference in Cape Verde on Friday. CAF's decision to stage the continental championship every four years had proved unpopular in many quarters. "We have discussed things over the last few days and are looking at everything, including having the AFCON come back every two years," Motsepe said. He announced in December that there would be Cup of Nations finals in 2027 and 2028, with the next one after that in 2032 and a four-year gap between tournaments to follow. This was to accommodate a new annual Nations League format that would fill up the calendar, which Motsepe said at the time would be more lucrative. The African continental championship, first staged in 1957, has usually been played every two years.

item.description: [ドーハ ９日 ロイター] - 米政府当局者は９日、ベセント財務長官が１０月１２─１８日にタイのバンコクで開催される...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ベセント米財務長官、ＩＭＦ・世銀会合欠席へ　国内日程優先＝当局筋 0:35 配信

[ドーハ　９日　ロイター] - 米政府当局者は９日、ベセント財務長官が１０月１２─１８日にタイのバンコクで開催される国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行の年次総会を欠席する見通しだと明らかにした。国内日程を優先するためとした。

米財務省は、ブルック財務副長官とブラウン財務次官（国際問題担当）が同省代表団を率いると確認した。

財務省は、年次総会で米当局者らが各国パートナーと協力し、成長を阻害してきた政策や構造的な不均衡の問題に取り組むとともに、「ソブリン債に対する透明性の向上とより効果的なアプローチ」を推進していくと述べた。

item.title: 高市首相、「深く懸念」と投稿 トランプ米政権のＩＣＣ制裁に
item.description: [東京 １０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[東京 １０日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は９日夜、米国が国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）に制裁を科したことを受け、「日本の立場と相容れるものではなく、深く懸念している」とソーシャルメディアに投稿した。「我が国は国際社会における法の支配を一貫して重視し、その役割を担うＩＣＣを支持している」と改めて表明した。

トランプ米政権はＩＣＣに批判的で、赤根智子所長をすでに制裁対象としている。

高市氏は「赤根所長や関係国との意思疎通も継続しつつ、ＩＣＣがその本来の役割と機能を果たせるよう必要な支援を行っていく」とした。

トランプ政権によるＩＣＣ制裁決定に先立ち、ノルウェーのノーベル賞委員会は９日、同裁判所で判事を務めたナビ・ピレイ氏にノーベル平和賞を授与することを発表した。ピレイ氏は、イスラエルがパレスチナ自治区ガザでジェノサイド（集団虐殺）を行ったと結論付けた国連報告書の取りまとめを主導した。

MANCHESTER, England, Oct 9 : Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick called for a swift resolution to Manchester City's financial charges case on Friday, saying the long-running process had raised many questions and affected him personally. Last month, an independent commission found City guilty of all charges relating to breaches of the Premier League's financial rules over nine seasons, between the 2009-10 and 2017-18 campaigns, as well as three of four charges concerning their failure to cooperate with the investigation. City, who currently top the Premier league table as the only side with a perfect record after five matches, have denied wrongdoing and lodged an appeal. Carrick spent 12 years at United from 2006 to 2018, winning five Premier League titles and the Champions League among numerous honours, before taking charge in January following Ruben Amorim's departure.

During his playing career, the 45-year-old former midfielder lost out in two title races won by City, including the 2011-12 campaign when United fell short on goal difference after Sergio Aguero's dramatic title-clinching goal on the final day. "Very difficult to say in many ways," Carrick told a press conference when asked about the City charges. "It's thrown up a lot of questions, some have had answers, some haven't. As it's still ongoing, and we don't know how long it's going to go, there's only so much I can say. "Certainly I've got my own questions about it, it's affected me personally in different ways over a period of time. But as the case is going now I don't know where that stands and how it's going to end up, so we'll just have to wait and see. "What I will say, the sooner it gets sorted I think for everyone's benefit is essential." Asked if he wants the titles United missed out on, Carrick said he would reserve judgement until the process was complete. "I think regardless of anything, a medal anyway, in any sport in history, I think later on you get the medal and it's proven at different times," the Englishman added. "It's the moment that you strive for to win and achieve in that moment, so the medal here or there, not getting blase about it, but that doesn't bring the feeling of when you initially win or you don't win. That's essentially what we're all in it for." Twelfth-placed United host bottom side Tottenham Hotspur on Saturday and have several injury concerns. "It's a bit mixed really through the internationals," Carrick said. "(Wing back) Patrick Dorgu came off and it looks like he'll be out probably for a number of weeks. "(Defender) Noussair Mazraoui came off and took a knock. He's not quite right yet, we'll have to see how he is." He added that Carlos Baleba was improving, while fellow midfielder Kobbie Mainoo, winger Amad Diallo and forward Marcus Rashford had resumed limited training. Striker Benjamin Sesko remains further away from a return.

Source: Reuters

Oct 9 : The US government said on Thursday it is suspending some major global tech and IT firms including Microsoft and Cognizant from a key green card program that allows skilled foreign workers to gain permanent residency through their employment. Senior US officials cited alleged fraud as the reason behind the move, saying companies have been using the program to replace American workers with cheaper foreign workers, and comes as the latest step in the Trump administration's crackdown on skilled foreign labor. WHAT IS UNDER SUSPENSION? The suspension is targeting a key employer-sponsorship mechanism, called the Permanent Labor Certification or PERM, which is used by major technology companies and outsourcing firms. The US government said that for certain companies, it would not accept any new PERM applications or process any pending ones.

PERM came into effect in 2005, aiming to speed up the long processing times experienced under the previous paper-based "Alien Employment Certification" program. Under PERM, the US Department of Labor (DOL) allows an employer to sponsor a foreign worker's permanent residency. The process is initiated by qualified US employers, and not individual workers. The Labor Department must certify to the US Citizenship and Immigration Services that there are not enough US workers that are qualified and available for a given job opportunity, and that the employment of the foreign worker will not affect the wages and working conditions of similarly employed Americans. Outside of PERM and family-based routes to permanent residency, individuals can also self-petition for green cards through processes such as the EB-1A application for individuals with extraordinary ability or the EB-2 National Interest Waiver. WHY IS IT IMPORTANT? The PERM program serves as a critical bridge between temporary work status and a green card for many foreign skilled workers. Many IT firms employ hundreds of thousands of workers who typically start on temporary work visas such as the H-1B, and later seek permanent residency. Without the option to be sponsored by their employer under PERM, foreign workers could lose a key route to permanent residency and would have to stay on temporary visas for longer. For companies, recruiting foreign talent could become harder, as many workers overseas view the path to permanent US residency as a key reason for taking a job. WHICH COMPANIES ARE UNDER SUSPENSION? The US said it is suspending Microsoft and Adobe along with some of the largest IT firms in the world, including Cognizant, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro, HCL Technologies and Capgemini. Other companies such as Meta, Amazon or Alphabet's Google remain free to participate in the program. WHY IS THE US FREEZING APPLICATIONS? The move widens an ongoing crackdown on visas for foreign workers, which the Trump administration has said cost US jobs. Vice President JD Vance said, without citing specific evidence, companies are using the PERM program to replace American employees with foreign workers and undercut their wages. Vance said on Thursday: "Our message to Microsoft is: You're a great American company, but you've got to hire great American workers." The suspensions follow President Trump's move to impose a one-time $100,000 fee on new H-1B visa petitions for highly skilled foreign workers, which has been blocked by federal court orders. HOW IS PERM DIFFERENT FROM H-1B? H-1B is a temporary work visa that allows skilled foreign workers to work in the US, generally for up to six years. PERM, meanwhile, is a permanent labor-certification process. The freeze does not appear to directly affect current holders of H-1B visas. HOW CURTAILING PERM COULD BACKFIRE Some experts said that while the PERM suspensions might target specific companies, such policies risk making the US less competitive globally by deterring highly skilled foreign talent. "It is a fallacy to think that you can protect American workers by keeping skilled foreign workers out of the country. You think that foreign talent competes with Americans within our borders, they'll certainly compete with Americans by working abroad," said Chad Sparber, Director of the Lampert Institute for Civic and Global Affairs at Colgate University. Ahmet Gulek, Postdoctoral Fellow at Stanford’s Immigration Policy Lab, said that permanent residency is the primary way for talented foreign workers to stay in the country and without it, some will leave, and some will not come in the first place, even temporarily.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Explainer-How the US plan to livestream an execution compares with global practice
item.description: The U.S. military plans to livestream the Dec. 3 execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, the former Army psychiatrist convicted of killing 13 people in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting.

Explainer-How the US plan to livestream an execution compares with global practice

Oct 9 (Reuters) – The U.S. military plans to livestream the Dec. 3 execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, the former Army psychiatrist convicted of killing 13 people in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting.

If carried out as planned, death penalty experts said it would mark the first known broadcast or livestream of a lawful execution.

Executions are generally conducted behind prison walls, and internet platforms and governments have spent years trying to limit the circulation of violent execution footage.

Show Full Article

HAS A LAWFUL EXECUTION EVER BEEN LIVESTREAMED OR BROADCAST TO THE PUBLIC BEFORE?

Death penalty experts consulted by Reuters said they were unaware of any previous lawful execution that had been livestreamed or broadcast to a public audience.

Execution footage has occasionally emerged after the event. The hanging of former Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein in 2006, for example, was seen around the world after official and unofficial recordings circulated online and through broadcasters, though it was not shown live.

Broadcasts and livestreams today are common for court proceedings, parliamentary debates and other state functions, but not for judicial executions.

HOW UNUSUAL IS THIS COMPARED WITH MODERN EXECUTION PRACTICES AROUND THE WORLD?

Public executions have become rare worldwide, with most countries that retain the death penalty carrying out executions away from public view.

According to Amnesty International, public executions recorded in recent years have largely been concentrated in Iran and Taliban-run Afghanistan.

The execution would also be notable in the United States. Public executions largely disappeared during the 20th century, and death penalty experts cited by Reuters said the last legally sanctioned public execution took place in 1936.

Hasan’s execution would be the first carried out by firing squad by the U.S. military since the 1945 execution of Eddie Slovik, who was convicted of desertion during World War Two.

HOW HAS THE INTERNET CHANGED THE CIRCULATION OF EXECUTION FOOTAGE?

The internet has transformed execution imagery from a local event into content capable of reaching global audiences within minutes.

Militant groups such as Islamic State became notorious for producing professionally edited execution videos that were distributed online as propaganda and recruitment tools.

Criminal organisations, including Mexican drug cartels, have also circulated violent footage to intimidate rivals and project power.

The ability of users to rapidly copy, repost and redistribute content has made it more difficult for governments and technology companies to control the spread of such material.

WHAT HAS BEEN THE REACTION FROM GOVERNMENTS AND TECH COMPANIES?

Governments and technology companies have generally moved in the opposite direction, attempting to reduce rather than expand access to graphic execution footage.

Major social media platforms have spent years removing execution videos linked to extremist organisations and other violent groups.

One of the first public governmental reactions came from New Zealand, whose chief censor said authorities would have little practical ability to prevent residents from accessing a livestream while it was taking place.

Livestreams pose particular challenges for platforms because footage can be viewed, copied and redistributed before moderation systems can intervene.

Even countries that still conduct public executions have often restricted filming and broadcast rights. Saudi Arabia historically carried out public executions before spectators, but recording them was prohibited and such public executions had largely ceased by 2019.

(Reporting by Hugo Lhomedet in Gdansk; Editing by Matt Scuffham)

Tesla renames 'Full Self-Driving' to 'Assisted Driving' in Europe as it chases clearance for software

Tesla electric vehicles are parked at a Tesla dealership, after Tesla, Inc. released its financial results for the first quarter of 2025, in Berlin, Germany April 23, 2025. REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

FAST

Oct 9 : EV-maker Tesla has started calling its "Full Self-Driving" feature "Tesla Assisted Driving" on its European websites, dropping a name regulators have said was misleading, as CEO Elon Musk pushes for EU-wide approval for the software. The rebrand comes after Germany said on Tuesday Tesla had offered to switch to the new name. Musk has described the self-driving technology as key to the company's future growth. Tesla's FSD page for Slovakia now redirects to a "Tesla Assisted Driving" page, as do pages in other European countries such as Germany, Spain and the Netherlands. The US site still refers to it as "Full Self-Driving (Supervised)." A Reuters report published this week detailed how Tesla mounted a campaign to win approval for FSD in Europe, including encouraging owners and supporters to lobby national regulators for faster approvals.

In September, a Norwegian Tesla owner asked the Norwegian Public Roads Administration whether Tesla's changes to how it described FSD addressed concerns about the name, according to documents Reuters obtained through freedom-of-information requests. "Please do not simply say again that 'we are waiting for the EU' without explaining what Tesla or Norway must deliver in the meantime," the owner said. Several regulators have said the old name is misleading because the system requires constant supervision and drivers remain legally responsible. In Sweden, consumer protection authorities had earlier asked the Swedish Transport Agency to assess whether the marketing of FSD could give buyers the false impression the system was capable of fully autonomous driving. In Italy, authorities had said in internal government correspondence that the name "Full Self-Driving", together with Tesla's promotional material, "could lead users to believe that the vehicle is equipped with unsupervised automatic driving functions attributable to higher levels of automation, particularly SAE Level 3", in communication seen by Reuters through freedom-of-information requests. Eight EU countries already allow the system, with Slovakia expecting to become the ninth within days. An EU-wide vote has been pushed from October to at least December, with countries like France conducting additional testing.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米財務長官、中国担当顧問にシェルトン氏起用 元ＦＲＢ理事候補
item.description: [９日 ロイター] - 米財務省は９日、ベセント財務長官が、中国情勢を重点的に担当する顧問としてジュディ・シェルトン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米財務長官、中国担当顧問にシェルトン氏起用　元ＦＲＢ理事候補 10/9 23:51 配信

2026年7月11日、米財務省庁舎。REUTERS/Daniel Heuer/File Photo/File Photo

[９日 ロイター] - 米財務省は９日、ベセント財務長官が、中国情勢を重点的に担当する顧問としてジュディ・シェルトン氏を起用したと発表した。同氏はトランプ米大統領がかつて連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）理事候補に指名した人物。

財務省によると、シェルトン氏は欧州復興開発銀行（ＥＢＲＤ）と全米民主主義基金（ＮＥＤ）を率いた経歴を持つ。インディペンデント研究所やスタンフォード大学フーバー研究所で研究員も務めた。

トランプ氏は第１次政権時、空席となっていたＦＲＢ理事にシェルトン氏を指名した。しかし、同氏の党派的と見られる姿勢がＦＲＢの独立性を損なう恐れがあるとの懸念が超党派で広がり、指名承認は難航した。

財務省は声明で「シェルトン氏は通貨政策について長官に助言し、特に中国の金融情勢の評価に重点を置く」と表明した。

FAST

TURIN, Oct 9 : Revolut plans to move beyond financial services and develop a broader suite of technology products, Chief Executive Nik Storonsky said on Friday, as Europe's most valuable startup pushes deeper into global markets. Storonsky said Revolut had developed proprietary AI models trained on customer transaction data, using techniques similar to those underpinning large language models. "With 30 to 40 million transactions taking place every day on Revolut, we have a unique dataset to build on," he said at the Wave by Vento tech forum in Turin, adding that his long-term goal was for Revolut to reach a scale comparable with the biggest US technology companies. Revolut's rapid growth has drawn regulatory scrutiny. In 2025, Lithuania's central bank imposed a record €3.5 million fine over shortcomings in transaction-monitoring controls, though the company said the investigation found no confirmed instances of money laundering and that it had strengthened its systems.

In September, Revolut accidentally sent customer data to hackers posing as government investigators. The company said its systems and customer funds were unaffected. Founded a little over a decade ago, Revolut was valued at $115 billion in a secondary share sale this year, up from $45 billion in 2024. It is now privately valued at more than the market capitalisation of Britain's Barclays or France's Societe Generale. The company has announced several new licences in recent weeks. It received preliminary approval for a national banking licence in the United States in September, after winning licences in Britain and France earlier this year. If Revolut were to list its shares, it would favor a primary listing in the US, Storonsky told Bloomberg TV on Thursday.

item.description: [ワシントン ９日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が９日発表した１０月の消費者信頼感指数（速報値）は４６．３と９月の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ミシガン大消費者信頼感、10月速報値46.3に低下　中東紛争の物価高響く 10/9 23:44 配信

米ニューヨークのスーパーマーケットで2025年11月撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[ワシントン　９日　ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が９日発表した１０月の消費者信頼感指数（速報値）は４６．３と９月の４８．１から低下した。中東紛争に伴う物価上昇が、家計の景況感を悪化させていることを示唆した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は４７．８だった。

１年先のインフレ期待は４．７％と、前月の４．６％から小幅上昇した。米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争が始まる前の２月時点では３．４％だった。

５年先のインフレ期待は３．５％。前月は３．４％だった。

消費者調査ディレクターのジョアン・スー氏は 「生活費を巡る不満は高まり続けており、政治的立場を問わず、消費者は年初から経済の見通しが弱まったと受け止めている」と指摘。「全体として、今月は低所得層や保有株式が少ない層の景況感が急激に悪化した。これらの層は物価上昇を乗り切るための余裕が少ない」と述べた。

item.title: US measles cases rise to 4,080, CDC says
item.description: The US CDC on Friday reported 4,080 confirmed measles cases in the country as of October 8, up 193 from a week earlier.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US CDC on Friday reported 4,080 confirmed measles cases in the country as of October 8, up 193 from a week earlier. Here are key details: Twenty-six cases were identified among international visitors, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Measles-related hospitalizations this year stand at 414, or 10% of cases, compared with 244 hospitalizations in 2025 The CDC has confirmed [USN:L4N45L13A TEXT:"two measles-associated deaths"] in 2026, though it has not identified the states involved, compared with three deaths in 2025 Separately, Pennsylvania health officials have reported [USN:L4N45M1NB TEXT:"five deaths"] linked to the state's measles outbreak this year Last month, the CDC shifted to using [USN:L4N45A17G TEXT:"mortality data"] from the National Center for Health Statistics for measles-related deaths, rather than relying on state health departments, a change that has drawn scrutiny As of October 9, the Pennsylvania health department has reported 1,136 measles cases in 2026, including 219 hospitalizations Children and teenagers aged 5 to 19 accounted for the largest share of cases at 1,716, or 42% of infections, followed by adults aged 20 and older at 1,635 cases, or 40% Earlier this week, New York [USN:L4N45R1BM TEXT:"declared"] a statewide disaster emergency over a measles outbreak after reporting 108 cases this year through October 3, including 92 cases since July 15

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-トランプ米政権、ＩＣＣに制裁 国務長官「運営能力低下させる」
item.description:
Humeyra Pamuk Steve Holland
[ハーグ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Humeyra Pamuk　Steve Holland

[ハーグ　９日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権は９日、国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁を科した。ＩＣＣにサービスを提供する企業も制裁対象となる可能性があり、トランプ政権が敵視してきたＩＣＣの活動能力を低下させる狙いがある。

公式発表に先立ち、ロイターが入手した声明によると、ルビオ国務長官は「米国はＩＣＣに制裁を科す。われわれはこの無法な裁判所との取引を禁止し、資金源を断ち、運営能力を著しく低下させる」と表明。「トランプ大統領は、ＩＣＣによる米国人の訴追を決して許さない」と述べた。また、今回の措置は、ＩＣＣと加盟国に対し米国の懸念に対処する機会を与えることを目的としていると説明した。

米国の制裁措置は通常、米国に拠点を置く全ての企業に対し、制裁対象となった組織との取引を禁じる。金融機関は口座の閉鎖、保険会社は契約の解除、ソフトウェア企業は協力関係の停止を迫られる可能性がある。

ただ今回は複数の例外措置も認められ、米財務省は、ＩＣＣの通信やソフトウェアなどに絡む取引の一部を許可する４件の包括的なライセンスを発行した。

米政権はこれまでに、ＩＣＣによるイスラエルのネタニヤフ首相らに対する逮捕状発行やアフガニスタン駐留米軍を巡る過去の捜査などに反発し、赤根智子所長らＩＣＣ関係者を制裁対象に指定してきた。

ＩＣＣは声明で「司法手続きを妨害し、裁判所が設立目的を果たすことを阻止しようとする試みで、法の支配そして国際法秩序の根幹に対する攻撃だ」と強く非難。その上で、加盟国に対し、ＩＣＣが引き続き機能していけるよう支援を求めた。

ＩＣＣのカーン副検察官もロイターに対し、米国の制裁措置は「国際的な法の支配と独立した司法機関の活動を弱体化させることを目的としている」とし、「非難されるべきだ」と批判した。同時に、制裁によってＩＣＣの活動が停止することはない言明した。

今回の制裁措置は、ノルウェーのノーベル賞委員会がナビ・ピレイ元ＩＣＣ判事へのノーベル平和賞授与を発表してからわずか数時間後に公表された。

item.title: How the US plan to livestream an execution compares with global practice
item.description: The U.S. military plans to livestream the Dec. 3 execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, the former Army psychiatrist convicted of killing 13 people in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The U.S. military plans to livestream the Dec. 3 execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, the former Army psychiatrist convicted of killing 13 people in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. If carried out as planned, death penalty experts said it would mark the first known broadcast or livestream of a lawful execution. Executions are generally conducted behind prison walls, and internet platforms and governments have spent years trying to limit the circulation of violent execution footage. HAS A LAWFUL EXECUTION EVER BEEN LIVESTREAMED OR BROADCAST TO THE PUBLIC BEFORE? Death penalty experts consulted by Reuters said they were unaware of any previous lawful execution that had been livestreamed or broadcast to a public audience. Execution footage has occasionally emerged after the event. The hanging of former Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein in 2006, for example, was seen around the world after official and unofficial recordings circulated online and through broadcasters, though it was not shown live. Broadcasts and livestreams today are common for court proceedings, parliamentary debates and other state functions, but not for judicial executions. HOW UNUSUAL IS THIS COMPARED WITH MODERN EXECUTION PRACTICES AROUND THE WORLD? Public executions have become rare worldwide, with most countries that retain the death penalty carrying out executions away from public view. According to Amnesty International, public executions recorded in recent years have largely been concentrated in Iran and Taliban-run Afghanistan. The execution would also be notable in the United States. Public executions largely disappeared during the 20th century, and death penalty experts cited by Reuters said the last legally sanctioned public execution took place in 1936. Hasan's execution would be the first carried out by firing squad by the U.S. military since the 1945 execution of Eddie Slovik, who was convicted of desertion during World War Two. HOW HAS THE INTERNET CHANGED THE CIRCULATION OF EXECUTION FOOTAGE? The internet has transformed execution imagery from a local event into content capable of reaching global audiences within minutes. Militant groups such as Islamic State became notorious for producing professionally edited execution videos that were distributed online as propaganda and recruitment tools. Criminal organisations, including Mexican drug cartels, have also circulated violent footage to intimidate rivals and project power. The ability of users to rapidly copy, repost and redistribute content has made it more difficult for governments and technology companies to control the spread of such material. WHAT HAS BEEN THE REACTION FROM GOVERNMENTS AND TECH COMPANIES? Governments and technology companies have generally moved in the opposite direction, attempting to reduce rather than expand access to graphic execution footage. Major social media platforms have spent years removing execution videos linked to extremist organisations and other violent groups. One of the first public governmental reactions came from New Zealand, whose chief censor said authorities would have little practical ability to prevent residents from accessing a livestream while it was taking place. Livestreams pose particular challenges for platforms because footage can be viewed, copied and redistributed before moderation systems can intervene. Even countries that still conduct public executions have often restricted filming and broadcast rights. Saudi Arabia historically carried out public executions before spectators, but recording them was prohibited and such public executions had largely ceased by 2019. (This story has been corrected to fix the year to 2001, not 2021, in paragraph 15.)

Oct 9 : Tickets for Tyson Fury's long-awaited heavyweight clash with Anthony Joshua at Cardiff's Principality Stadium sold out within an hour of going on sale on Friday, British media reported. The all-British bout, announced last month, has generated huge interest and has been billed as the biggest in British boxing history. Around 80,000 tickets went on sale at midday, with prices ranging from £88.50 pounds ($117) to £13,128 ($17,357) including booking fees, the BBC reported.  More than 500,000 fans were reportedly in the online queue within minutes of sales opening.
