Fury and Joshua are scheduled to headline a December 11 card, although their ring walks are expected to begin at around 1 a.m. on December 12. According to an application submitted to Cardiff City Council, Principality Stadium would remain open until 3.30 a.m. on December 12. The fight between the former world champions is being broadcast on Netflix and Saudi money man Turki Alalshikh had hoped initially that it could be staged at New York's Madison Square Garden. The contest will mark the first meeting between the former world heavyweight champions, ending years of speculation over a matchup that many feared might never happen. ($1 = 0.7564 pounds)

item.title: 盗難のルノワール絵画を回収、6人逮捕 仏南部
item.description: [パリ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ９日 ロイター] - フランス南部リビエラ地方カーニュシュルメールにあるルノワール美術館で９月、印象派の巨匠ルノワールの絵画２点が盗まれた事件で、地元市長は９日、数百万ドル相当とされる２点が回収され、容疑者６人を逮捕したと発表した。

これら２点は「コロンナ・ロマーノ夫人の肖像」と「井戸のそばの若い女性」。いずれもパリのオルセー美術館が所蔵し、ルノワール美術館に寄託されていた。

９月に発生した事件では、犯行グループはフェンスに穴を開けて美術館に侵入し、絵画４点を盗んだ。駆け付けた警察が追跡し、犯人らは逃走中に庭へ２点を落とし、そのまま逃げ去った。

マルセイユ検察庁は、残る２点がどのように回収されたかとの質問には回答していない。

item.title: US immigration chiefs defend shooting of New York man, attack 'sanctuary' policies
item.description: US immigration officials defended federal agents on Friday who shot and wounded a New York City man in his car with a young child believed to be his son in the back seat and rebuked Mayor Zohran Mamdani for his condemnation of immigration agents.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Allen, Joseph Ax
item.content:encoded: US immigration officials defended federal agents on Friday who shot and wounded a New York City man in his car with a young child believed to be his son in the back seat and rebuked Mayor Zohran Mamdani for his condemnation of immigration agents. US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said at a press conference that officers did not know the child was in the car at the time they opened fire and accused the man, a Dominican who was the target of the operation, of endangering both officers and the child. The man, identified by officials as Oscar Belgal, refused to exit his car when approached by Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers on Thursday afternoon in Marble Hill, Manhattan's northernmost neighborhood. Before Belgal, federal immigration officers had shot at least 21 people, killing 7 of them, across the US since President Donald Trump returned to office in January 2025 promising record-breaking deportations, an unusually high number for civil law enforcement operations. Marcos Charles, a senior ICE official, said at the press conference that Belgal accelerated his car and struck two ICE vehicles and appeared to be "going towards officers" when they began shooting. In other violent incidents, initial accounts from ICE or the Department of Homeland Security have repeatedly been contradicted by video and other evidence, sometimes in court, and Reuters was unable to verify Charles' account. Belgal suffered a superficial wound to his neck, Charles said. He is being held in a detention facility outside New York state. Belgal's 5-year-old son was in the back seat at the time, according to police. Belgal can be seen sitting by a car with his hands cuffed behind him and patches of what appear to be fresh blood on the tarmac in a three-minute body-worn camera video released by the New York Police Department on Friday, with several agents dressed in plain clothes standing around him. One is holding a rifle and wearing a fluorescent reflective vest. A crowd of angry onlookers gathered outside a corner store shouts at the agents from the sidewalk. Several city police officers pick up Belgal by his arms and legs, put him in their car and take him to a hospital. "Yo, put pressure, put pressure!" one of the police officers instructs his colleagues with Belgal in the back of the police car. Mullin said body-worn camera video from ICE agents would also be released. Belgal is a Dominican who is in the country illegally and had previously evaded an effort by ICE agents to apprehend him in September, according to US officials. He pleaded guilty last year to fourth-degree grand larceny for stealing something from another person, leading to a sentence of five years on probation, and is due in court in December on charges of criminal sale of a controlled substance, to which he pleaded not guilty, according to New York court records. Speaking to reporters late on Thursday at the scene of the shooting, Mamdani, noting he himself was an immigrant, condemned ICE as "rotten to the core" and said he had tried unsuccessfully to secure Belgal's release in phone calls with Trump and Mullin. Mamdani said the shooting is "further devastating confirmation of what we have long known, which is that ICE operates with impunity, that they sow chaos and terror across our country, that they have killed far more of our neighbors than they could ever have claimed to save." In response on Friday, Mullin attacked Mamdani and criticized New York's "sanctuary" policies, which restrict how much city agencies and police cooperate with immigration authorities unless a person has been convicted of violent or otherwise serious felonies. Trump says aggressive efforts to deport immigrants are necessary to protect the safety of native-born Americans. Public defenders at agencies that have represented Belgal in court also condemned the shooting. Legal Aid said in a statement the shooting amounted to "an urgent call to rein in ICE's use of force and hold federal immigration agents accountable," calling on city prosecutors to investigate the agents involved.

item.title: Trump renews bid to fire Fed's Cook with fresh White House inquiry
item.description: US President Donald Trump launched a new inquiry into Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook weeks before congressionalelections, convening an investigative committee and ordering an unprecedented White House hearing into allegations she made false statements on mortgage applications.
item.dc:creator: Ann Saphir
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump launched a new inquiry into Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook weeks before congressional elections , convening an investigative committee and ordering an unprecedented White House hearing into allegations she made false statements on mortgage applications. Trump has been trying to fire Cook for more than a year as he moves to exert more control over a central bank he says is refusing for political reasons to lower interest rates. Lawyers for Cook said on Friday any fair hearing would show there is no legal basis for firing her. "As President, it is my job to ensure the laws are faithfully executed, including by firing subordinates who cannot be trusted to tell the truth and follow the law," Trump said in a notice on the White House website on Friday. "To assist me in carrying out that responsibility, the Committee shall investigate the allegations against Governor Cook and report to me whether there is 'cause' for Governor Cook’s removal," according to the notice, dated October 7. The committee will hold a closed, in-person four-hour hearing at the White House on November 5 "to consider the evidence and allegations against Governor Cook," the presidential memorandum said. The hearing falls two days after elections that will determine if Trump's Republican Party maintains control of the House and Senate, whose members are charged with confirming presidential nominees to the Fed. A successful removal of Cook would create a vacancy on the Fed's seven-member Board. If the hearing is "anything close to objective, the conclusion will be that Governor Cook did not commit mortgage fraud, leaving no cause to remove her from the Federal Reserve Board," Cook's lawyers Abbe Lowell and Norm Eisen said in a statement. "Governor Cook welcomes the opportunity to present the facts so she can clear her name and demonstrate there is no legal basis to fire her.” They said they had engaged with the White House about the process. Trump first tried to fire Cook, the first Black woman to serve on the central bank's board, in August 2025. No president has ever tried to fire a sitting Fed governor before. Central banks are widely seen as needing political independence to ensure their ability to fight inflation as needed. SUPREME COURT RULING ON FED REMOVAL Cook sued, saying she had done nothing wrong. The case led to the US Supreme Court [USN:S0N3WN0AW TEXT:"ruling"] earlier this year that the president could not remove a Fed governor at will, and needed to follow a clear process laying out a 'cause' for firing and allowing for a defense. The ruling left Cook in her position but kicked the case against her back to a federal district court, where Judge Kia Cobb last month set a November 6 deadline for Trump's and Cook's lawyers to submit a joint proposal for the proceedings. Cook was appointed to the Fed board in 2022 by former President Joe Biden, a Democrat, and was reappointed in 2023 to a term that lasts until 2038. She has always cast her vote with the majority on the Fed's policy-making committee, which last month raised interest rates under the leadership of Kevin Warsh, whom Trump appointed to succeed Jerome Powell in May. "Trump appears to believe that the reason the Fed has turned hawkish is because his chosen chairman Warsh is boxed in by a hawkish and politically hostile Fed Board," Evercore ISI analyst Krishna Guha wrote. Trump's creation of the inquiry committee "constitutes a re-upping of his threat to Fed independence and will be counterproductive in terms of the President’s desire for lower interest rates." Trump's chief economic policy advisor Kevin Hassett, Equal Employment Opportunity Commission chair Andrea Lucas, and acting Office of Government Ethics director Keith Sonderling will comprise the newly formed committee, the memorandum said. Those members, their representatives, or Department of Justice personnel will question Cook for "no longer than four hours." The committee will make its recommendation to Trump on whether he has cause to remove Cook "as soon as practicable" after a November 10 deadline for Cook to submit any post-hearing statement, the memo said. Senator Elizabeth Warren, the top Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee that oversees the Fed, called the hearing a "kangaroo court" and part of Trump's "dangerous quest to illegally take over our nation’s central bank." Trump has contended Powell, who has remained at the Fed as governor, may have engaged in financial misconduct related to the Fed's building renovations, an allegation that sparked a now-closed Department of Justice criminal investigation and was rejected last month by an independent watchdog agency.

item.title: US imposes sanctions on ICC hours after former judge wins Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: The Trump administration has long been hostile to the court and has previously imposed sanctions on its prosecutors and judges.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Steve Holland, Anthony Deutsch
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump's administration imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court on Friday, hours after one of its [USN:L8N45V0JG TEXT:"former judges won the Nobel Peace Prize"], putting Washington on a diplomatic collision course with European allies. The court denounced the move as an "assault on the rule of law and on the very foundations of the international legal order," and called on its 125 member states to take action to defend it. "The Court cannot stand alone. Its fate now rests also in the hands of the states that created it," it said in a statement. "This is not just about defending a single institution, but about safeguarding the international order grounded upon the rule of law. History will judge this moment." The Trump administration has long been hostile to the court, founded in 2002 [USN:L6N3VQ0DE TEXT:"to prosecute war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide"], and has previously [USN:O8N42O02H TEXT:"imposed sanctions on its prosecutors and judges"]. Friday's move goes much further, potentially punishing companies that provide services to the court itself, amounting to an unprecedented attack on an institution founded on an international treaty. The US initially signed the Rome Statute that founded the court but never ratified it. "President Trump will never allow the International Criminal Court to prosecute Americans," Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in a statement, first published by Reuters. "That is why, today, the United States is sanctioning the International Criminal Court. We will ban transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate." SANCTIONS INCLUDE GRACE PERIOD The US Treasury announced the sanctions with a six-month initial grace period, and some other exemptions that would allow some transactions for telecoms, software, payment of pensions and transactions related to detainees. Rubio said the sanctions had been structured to give the court and its member states an opportunity to address US concerns, and would be adjusted if those demands were not met. Washington has denounced the ICC over arrest warrants issued for Israeli officials including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, and an investigation into actions of US soldiers in Afghanistan, which the ICC says is "deprioritized." Rubio in his statement cited calls from outside experts for the ICC to prosecute American service members, border patrol agents and elected leaders. ICC officials have not taken steps toward such prosecutions. "The sanctions are intended to undermine the rule of law internationally and the work that an independent judicial institution is doing," ICC Deputy Prosecutor Nazhat Shameem Khan told Reuters. "Our work will continue across all our situations, our investigations and our prosecutions." EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said on social media that the six-month period "offers a window for dialogue" but added that the bloc "has options to ensure that (the ICC) can continue its vital work." Belgium's foreign minister called for an EU blocking statute to be activated to protect the court. The ICC has issued arrest warrants against more than 70 people, including world leaders and major figures in global conflicts. In addition to Netanyahu, it has sought the arrest of Hamas figures. Others who were the subject of arrest warrants include Russian President Vladimir Putin, former Sudan President Omar al-Bashir and former Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi. Charges against Kenyan President William Ruto and former Kenyan President Uhuru Kenyatta were withdrawn. NOBEL COMMITTEE CITES POLITICAL ATTACKS IN AWARDING PRIZE Despite [USN:L6N45G1AB TEXT:"US calls for countries to quit the court"], it has received strong backing from most member states, which include all EU countries and all members of the NATO alliance apart from the United States and Turkey. It is based in the Netherlands, an EU and NATO member. The Nobel Prize awarded hours earlier to South African jurist Navi Pillay, who sat on the ICC's Appeals Chamber from 2003-2008, was explicitly described by the prize committee as a gesture of support for such tribunals at a time when "judges and institutions of international law are under political attack". "An international legal system in which war criminals are held to account and the victims of abuse see justice served is a precondition for a peaceful world," the prize committee said. US sanctions typically bar all US-based companies from any work with a sanctioned organization, forcing banks to shut accounts, insurers to end coverage and software companies to halt cooperation. The Trump administration previously imposed targeted sanctions on court officials during his first term, which were rescinded under President Joe Biden. Washington announced new sanctions just days after Trump returned to office in January 2025. Court officials have been preparing for months for the prospect of [USN:L6N45D0HW TEXT:"sanctions on the court"] itself, shifting office computers from Microsoft software to open-source equivalents and making new arrangements for banking and health insurance.

item.title: Verstappen pips Russell to sprint pole at Singapore Grand Prix
item.description: Red Bull's Max Verstappen took pole position for the Singapore Grand Prix sprint race on Friday, pipping Mercedes driver George Russell who will join him on the front row at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.
item.dc:creator: Rohith Nair, Tom Westbrook
item.content:encoded: Red Bull's Max Verstappen took pole position for the Singapore Grand Prix sprint race on Friday, pipping Mercedes driver George Russell who will join him on the front row at the Marina Bay Street Circuit. Verstappen, who had never previously taken pole or won a race in Singapore, set the fastest time of one minute 31.156 seconds, 0.120 seconds quicker than Russell. "It's closer in Singapore. Your lap itself, you're pushing as hard as you think is possible, close to the walls in places," Verstappen said. "Once we bolted on the soft tyres, it felt like the car was coming alive a little bit more. But I did not expect this, so, of course, very happy to be first. "The last few races we've been a lot stronger, but of course this track still highlights a few little weaknesses in the car. But we managed to drive with them as well as possible." Verstappen was investigated by the stewards for overtaking Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton under yellow flags in SQ1. However, they accepted the Dutchman's explanation that braking would have potentially created an unsafe situation and that he had reduced his speed by lifting off the throttle afterwards. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc was third fastest while Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli, who leads Russell by 84 points, was only seventh quickest. RUSSELL SATISFIED WITH P2 Russell was [USN:L4N45V0BZ TEXT:"fastest in the only practice session"] earlier on Friday but his power unit penalty will not affect his position on the grid for Saturday's sprint. However, the FIA handed the Briton a 40-place grid penalty for Sunday after he incurred a 10-place penalty for each of four additional elements, effectively consigning him to [USN:L4N45T0QW TEXT:"the back of the pack"]. "We've been competitive all day, from the first laps in FP1. We obviously topped the timesheets there," Russell said. "We knew Max was fast and he went on a slightly different strategy from us in Q3, just doing the one lap. Who knows what was best, but pretty satisfied with the P2. "It's going to be very challenging. The grip left to right here is a big difference. The drivers on the pole side last year had a big advantage, so it's probably going to be trying to maintain P2." FIRST SESSION RED-FLAGGED The first sprint qualifying session was red flagged when Cadillac's Sergio Perez crashed into a barrier and attempted to nurse his car back into the pits, leaving debris from his front wing on the track which needed to be removed by marshals. That effectively gave drivers one lap to advance to SQ2 and Verstappen was one of the last drivers to set a lap time, with the Dutchman topping the timesheets. A glitch in the systems delayed the start of SQ2, with the FIA saying some lap times had not been registered. But the FIA added that the issue had been resolved and the "current timings are considered correct." Moreover, "Overtake Mode" was not available after the red flag period during SQ1. It was then activated for a period of 27 seconds before being deactivated again. "The FIA acknowledges that this unfortunate human error had an impact on the performance of certain cars based on the timing of their run and their position around the lap," it said. "The second and third periods of Sprint Qualifying were not affected." A [USN:L6N45Q089 TEXT:"software bug"] had also caused chaos last weekend, with cars slowing to a crawl on two formation laps held after heavy rain at Sepang had forced the original start of the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia to be aborted.

Oct 9 : SpaceX has agreed to acquire a nationwide portfolio of licenses in the low-band spectrum in a deal reportedly valued at $8 billion, as it looks to expand beyond satellite internet and become a serious competitor in the US mobile market. The company first disclosed its plans to enter the mobile services sector during its inaugural earnings call in August. The announcement briefly weighed on shares of the three major US wireless carriers - AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon - as investors assessed the potential competitive threat. WHAT IS LOW-BAND SPECTRUM? Low-band spectrum refers to airwaves that can travel farther and penetrate buildings better than higher frequencies, making them useful for broad-area mobile coverage.

This differs from mid- and high-band spectrum, which can carry more data at a faster speed but cover less area. SpaceX has agreed to acquire up to 14 megahertz of paired spectrum in the 800 MHz low-band spectrum licenses from Grain Management, with plans to develop a hybrid architecture for Starlink Mobile that combines terrestrial infrastructure with satellite connectivity. HOW DOES THE US SPECTRUM LICENSING SYSTEM WORK? Commercial spectrum is a scarce resource in the US, regulated by the Federal Communications Commission, which typically assigns licenses for specific frequencies and geographic areas through auctions or other authorized processes. License holders must comply with technical rules and deployment requirements, but before that comes the transfer of licenses, which generally requires regulatory approval. The latest SpaceX deal for spectrum licenses is awaiting FCC approval. WHAT SPECTRUM DO THE THREE MAJOR CARRIERS HOLD? AT&T's low-band portfolio includes 700 MHz and 850 MHz spectrum, as well as 600 MHz licenses acquired through its July EchoStar deal. Verizon holds spectrum in the 700 MHz and 850 MHz bands, while T-Mobile's low-band holdings include 600 MHz and 700 MHz spectrum. WHAT IS THE PLAN FOR STARLINK MOBILE? The company plans to integrate the spectrum into its next-generation satellite system, while also deploying ground-based radios and antennas on towers and rooftops. The FCC approved Starlink Mobile's Gen2 constellation application this week, authorizing SpaceX to launch 15,000 satellites optimized for 2 GHz spectrum worldwide.

Source: Reuters

item.title: アングル：日韓で不正アクセスの「じゅうたん爆撃」、ＡＩ使いサイバー攻撃が手軽に
item.description:
(検索コードを修正しました)
Kentaro Okasaka Kyu-seok Shim Brenda Goh
[東...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アングル：日韓で不正アクセスの「じゅうたん爆撃」、ＡＩ使いサイバー攻撃が手軽に 10/9 22:01 配信

９月２３日撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Dado Ruvic/Illustration）

(検索コードを修正しました)

Kentaro Okasaka　Kyu-seok Shim　Brenda Goh

[東京 ９日 ロイター] - 日本と韓国でサイバー攻撃が相次ぎ、政府や企業が早急な対応を迫られている。クラウドサービスも攻撃された日本ではここ数週間で情報漏えいが急増し、韓国では複数の金融機関が同時に被害を受けた。専門家は、人工知能（ＡＩ）の普及で高度な技術を持たない犯罪者でも攻撃を仕掛けやすくなり、サイバー犯罪がより手軽かつ低コストになっていると警鐘を鳴らす。

＜「危急の状況」、政府に強まる警戒感＞

足元で急増する日本企業への不正アクセスは、金融の大和証券や損保ジャパン、小売りのブックオフグループホールディングスやローソン、飲食の焼肉きんぐ、カーシェアを運営するタイムズモビリティなど業界を問わず広範にわたる。特にソフトバンク子会社でクラウド事業を手がけるＩＤＣフロンティアが攻撃を受けた影響は大きく、契約する４９５の企業と自治体でサイトが閲覧できなくなったり、情報が流出したりした。今も復旧しておらず、保管していた一部のデータは復元や取り出しが困難だという。

「事案の背景や相互の関連性などは明らかではないが、情報収集を行い実態把握に努めている」。木原稔官房長官が会見でこう語った日本政府は８日、関係省庁会議を開いて対応を協議した。経済産業省は９日、所管する業界団体を通じて幅広く注意喚起することを明らかにした。金融庁は同日、金融機関などに対しサイバーセキュリティー対策の強化と本人確認手続きの厳格化を求める注意喚起を行った。

韓国では銀行９行や大型教会が、ＡＩツールが使われた可能性のあるサイバー攻撃を受けている。米サイバーセキュリティー企業クラウドストライクは、背後にいるとみられる中国在住の２６歳の容疑者について、ＡＩの支援なしには今回の攻撃を実行できなかった可能性が高いとの見方を示した。この人物は金銭的利益を目的としており、中国製のＡＩエージェントや米ＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックの「クロード・コード」を使用していたという。

同社の対敵対者作戦担当シニア・バイスプレジデント、アダム・マイヤーズ氏は、「（ハッカーの）能力はそれほど高度ではなかったが、十分に効果的だった」と述べた。その上で、韓国の銀行への攻撃事案は、ＡＩの進化に伴い、より強固なセキュリティー管理体制と厳格な検証の必要性を浮き彫りにしたと語った。「いわば、パンドラの箱は開けられた」

ＡＩは攻撃を容易にするだけでなく、防御側が不審な動きを見つけることも難しくしている。韓国・嘉泉大学のチェ・ギョンジン氏は「汎用ＡＩモデルを使えば、悪意を持った一般の利用者でも脆弱性を探すよう指示するだけで、その作業の多くをＡＩに任せることができる」と指摘する。

＜日本語の「壁」を越えるＡＩ＞

日本の場合、不正アクセスが続発している原因がＡＩの進化と関係しているのかまだ分かっていない。ただ、専門家によると、ＡＩを使えばソフトウエアの脆弱性探索やフィッシング攻撃に使う文章の作成などを自動化できる。攻撃にかかる時間やコストが減る一方、発見は難しくなっているという。

トレンドＡＩによると、日本に拠点を置く組織のサイバーセキュリティー事案は今年１─９月ですでに昨年１年間を上回った。９月は８６件と、８月から約１８％、７月からは約３７％増えた。９日もＪＲ東日本や旅行サイトのスカイチケットが情報流出を発表した。

サイバーセキュリティー会社、Ｓ＆Ｊ（東京都港区）の三輪信雄社長は「チャットＧＰＴの性能が上がったのと同じで、サイバー攻撃もどこかでこれまでの常識が通じないほどのブレークスルーを迎えた」と指摘する。これまで海外のハッカーは日本語という「壁」に守られた日本企業を敬遠しがちだったが、ＡＩを使えば言語の垣根はなくなる。「ＡＩに苦手はない。英語圏は大概、刈り尽くし、今回は日本が特にじゅうたん爆撃のようにやられている」と語る。

＜防御側はギアを２段階上げる必要＞

ＡＩを悪用したサイバー攻撃の広がりには、ＡＩを開発する側も警戒を強めている。アルファベット傘下のグーグルと、アンソロピックはいずれも、ＡＩを使った攻撃が世界的に増加していると警告している。グーグルの脅威インテリジェンス・グループのチーフアナリスト、ジョン・ハルトクイスト氏は先月、「現時点で、すべての脅威アクターが何らかの形でＡＩを使い、その恩恵を受けていると考えていい」と述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｊの三輪氏は、「オンラインでＢｔｏＣ（消費者向け事業）をやっている会社の数からすると（攻撃された企業数は）ほんのひとかけらで、刈り尽くすまではまだまだ時間はかかる。今後も（件数は）高止まりするだろう」と語る。「攻撃を受けてから会議を開いていては間に合わない。われわれの対応もギアを２段階上げ、ブレークスルーしていかないといけない」

（岡坂健太郎、Kyu-Seok Shim、Brenda Goh、Sam Nussey　編集：久保信博）

item.title: Wolff dismisses 'brainless' speculation of favouritism at Mercedes
item.description: Mercedes Formula One boss Toto Wolff rubbished talk his team favours championship leader Kimi Antonelli, calling critics "brainless," as stablemate George Russell's title chances fade with a penalty putting him at the back of the grid in Singapore.
item.dc:creator: Tom Westbrook
item.content:encoded: Mercedes Formula One boss Toto Wolff rubbished talk his team favours championship leader Kimi Antonelli, calling critics "brainless," as stablemate George Russell's title chances fade with a penalty putting him at the back of the grid in Singapore. "They're brainless, whoever thinks that," Wolff told reporters when asked what he would say to those who believe Antonelli is being given advantageous treatment. Antonelli, who is running an upgraded car on the Marina Bay Street Circuit, has won eight races this season to his luckless teammate's three. He leads Russell, who retired at last week's race with a failed engine, by 84 points going into the Singapore Grand Prix, where a penalty for going through his regulation four engines will put Russell at the back of the starting grid. Favouritism is "completely nonsensical," Wolff said. "I've always tried since I came into Formula One, even in my Williams days, to be the most balanced and the most transparent with the drivers," he said, recalling a conversation years ago on the grid with Alain Prost about his arch-rival Ayrton Senna. "I said: 'Just out of interest, why did it go so wrong between you and Senna?' And he said: 'Because we never knew what the team was about.' "So, I took it as my challenge to keep it always balanced. And it was not easy with Lewis and Nico back in the day," he said, referring to tension between then-teammates Lewis Hamilton and Nico Rosberg at Mercedes under Wolff a decade ago. This week, the team has reverted Russell to an older car setup in Singapore and he set the [USN:L4N45V0BZ TEXT:"fastest"] time in Friday's practice session. "We have had Kimi since he was 11 ... (and) George, who's been with us since he was 17," said Wolff. "We are very close. "That's why it's pretty annoying to have some lunatics that have no understanding, really, about how relationships work, coming up with these kind of accusations. "Most important is that George knows how the team is and Kimi knows. We will always try to give them equal opportunity, and when it comes to the upgrade, it's a good example - we don't know which one is going to be quicker."

item.title: Euro cae y anota quinta caída semanal consecutiva ante el alza de los precios del petróleo
item.description: El euro anotó el viernes su quinta baja semanal seguida tras revertir alzas iniciales ante un repunte de los precios del petróleo; aunque la presión vendedora reciente se atenuó gracias a la estabilización del maltrecho mercado de bonos francés.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
item.content:encoded: El euro anotó el viernes su quinta baja semanal seguida tras revertir alzas iniciales ante un repunte de los precios del petróleo; aunque la presión vendedora reciente se atenuó gracias a la estabilización del maltrecho mercado de bonos francés. * La moneda única registró el lunes su mínimo en 17 meses, en 1,1161 dólares, ante la preocupación de los inversores por la deuda pública récord de Francia y el difícil camino político hacia los recortes presupuestarios, en contraste con una economía y una moneda estadounidenses que parecen sólidas. * El índice dólar subió un 0,13% a 102,25 unidades, para anotar un avance de alrededor del 0,3% en la semana y marcar su cuarta alza semanal consecutiva, su racha más larga desde mayo de 2025. * El euro perdió un 0,1%, a 1,1198 dólares y registró un descenso de alrededor del 0,5% en la semana, en su racha más larga de caídas semanales frente al dólar desde inicios de 2025. * Los mercados mundiales de bonos se habían calmado más temprano el viernes, ante una baja de los precios del crudo después de que el presidente Donald Trump afirmara que Estados Unidos no atacaría a Irán antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato del 3 de noviembre y añadiera que se habían mantenido conversaciones productivas con Teherán sobre la guerra. * "Tal y como están las cosas, hay una confluencia de factores: los precios del petróleo son más altos, está el asunto de Francia, así que es realmente difícil decir qué está influyendo más en el mercado", dijo Eugene Epstein, director de operaciones y productos estructurados de Moneycorp en Stamford, Connecticut. * "Pero, en la práctica, diría que hoy nos encontramos en una situación de relativo estancamiento", añadió. * Los retornos de los bonos en todo el mundo han subido en las últimas semanas ante las expectativas de alzas de tasas de interés por parte de los bancos centrales, así como a las preocupaciones sobre las finanzas públicas. * No obstante, las expectativas de una subida de tasas de interés por parte de la Fed a fines de octubre siguen moderadas: según CME FedWatch, los mercados descuentan una probabilidad del 19,4% de un incremento de al menos 25 puntos básicos. * La libra esterlina subió un 0,08%, a 1,3235 dólares, pero anotó su séptima semana consecutiva de caídas, su racha más larga desde noviembre de 2024. * Frente al yen , el dólar ganó un 0,25% a 158,25 yenes. La moneda japonesa marcó su cuarta semana seguida de caídas frente al dólar, con un descenso de alrededor del 0,2%.

BENGALURU, Oct 9 : India's telecom minister said on Friday the country does not allow monopolies in any sector, pushing back after Elon Musk suggested billionaire Mukesh Ambani was using political influence to block Starlink's launch in the country. "India does not allow a monopoly in any sector," telecom minister Jyotiraditya Scindia said at a media briefing on Friday, addressing Musk's remarks. Musk's SpaceX unit is seeking entry into a telecom market with more than a billion internet users, currently dominated by the mobile networks of Ambani's Reliance Jio and Sunil Mittal's Bharti Airtel. "Is Ambani the real boss of India?", Musk wrote on X on Thursday, questioning why Starlink still lacked a license despite what he said were years of compliance with Indian requirements. He provided no evidence against Ambani.

Ambani's Reliance Jio did not respond to a request for comments on Musk's remarks. A four-year wait to launch Starlink's satellite internet services in India has sparked heated exchanges online over business influence and regulatory delays, with Musk targeting Ambani and the political opposition joining the row. While Starlink has already secured a licence to operate in India, a commercial launch still requires it to meet security compliance conditions and receive a spectrum assignment. The government said on Thursday that all three licensed satellite operators including Starlink were at broadly the same regulatory stage, calling suggestions of an unfair or discriminatory process "baseless and misconceived".

item.title: Hurkacz hands Djokovic early Shanghai exit with first win over Serb
item.description: Poland's Hubert Hurkacz beat Novak Djokovic for the first time as he dumped the four-times champion out of the Shanghai Masters with a 6-4 6-3 second-round victory on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Poland's Hubert Hurkacz beat Novak Djokovic for the first time as he dumped the four-times champion out of the Shanghai Masters with a 6-4 6-3 second-round victory on Friday. Tenth seed Djokovic arrived in Shanghai fresh from winning a [USN:L6N45S0UI TEXT:"record seventh China Open"] crown after Australia's Alex de Minaur retired with a groin injury in Tuesday's final. The 24-times Grand Slam champion, whose last Shanghai title came in 2018, had an 8-0 record against 29-year-old Hurkacz. But the Pole, a former world number six, produced a clinical display, firing 13 aces and 28 winners while conceding little on serve to beat Djokovic in one hour and 27 minutes in his first Shanghai appearance since capturing the title in 2023. Hurkacz, who missed the tournament in 2024 and 2025, extended his winning streak in Shanghai to eight matches and now faces either Italy's Lorenzo Musetti or China's Zhou Yi. The defeat marked the latest setback in a testing season for the 39-year-old Serbian, who suffered a shock first-round exit at the US Open, his earliest Grand Slam defeat since the 2006 Australian Open. "I was not close to what I was playing in Beijing," Djokovic said. "I'm slightly more tired, not fresh ... "I didn't feel myself on the court in terms of feeling the ball. It's a super quick surface, completely different from Beijing. "If you lose your serve, it is enough to lose the match, once per set, and that is what happened. It is very difficult to return his serve, almost impossible. So yeah, I did not adjust and it was a really tough draw for me, playing him in the first match." Djokovic will now turn his attention to the European indoor swing, with next month's Paris Masters looming. He is ninth in the race for a spot at the season-ending ATP Finals in Turin. "I am planning on only playing in Paris, so let's see. Hopefully I can have a good result there," he added. TOP SEED ZVEREV MARCHES ON French and US Open champion Zverev remained firmly on track in Shanghai in his bid to secure the year-end world number one ranking by seeing off local favourite Wu Yibing 6-4 7-6(4). The German world number two can ensure he will reach the pinnacle by the end of the year if he makes the semi-finals or if his nearest challengers Carlos Alcaraz and Ben Shelton lose at any stage of the Masters 1000 tournament. [USN:L1N45S0CV TEXT:"Jannik Sinner"] is currently the top-ranked player, but the Italian ended his season prematurely due to inflammation in his knee and will drop the points he earned for winning the Vienna Open, the Paris Masters and the ATP Finals last year. The only blemish on an otherwise perfect day for top seed Zverev was a minor injury scare at 5-5 in the second set, when the 29-year-old slipped and fell near the baseline and then clutched his left ankle. Memories of the serious ankle injury he suffered in the 2022 French Open semi-finals briefly resurfaced but Zverev recovered and completed the win in the ensuing tiebreak to book a meeting with Frenchman Quentin Halys. Earlier, US Open runner-up Shelton celebrated his 24th birthday with a 6-3 7-6(6) win over German Daniel Altmaier but it was the end of the road for Roland Garros finalist Flavio Cobolli, who fell 6-1 4-6 6-3 to Frenchman Adrian Mannarino.

FAST

WILMINGTON, Delaware, Oct 9 : A lawsuit by chipmaker Qualcomm against chip technology supplier Arm Holdings will head on Friday to a jury charged with determining if Arm breached licensing agreements and intentionally sabotaged some of Qualcomm's dealings with Meta Platforms. The five-day trial is the second in two years between the companies and highlights the deterioration of their business relationship after SoftBank Group Corp acquired control of Arm in 2016 and Arm shifted from licensing the technology needed to make chips to selling chips of its own. At stake is whether Qualcomm, whose license for Arm's computing architecture runs until 2033, can eventually agree to terms for new versions of Arm's architecture. Qualcomm wants the jury to find that Arm breached its licensing agreements by withholding software patches and tools for its designs and by violating an agreement that was meant to ensure Qualcomm paid within 10 per cent of the lowest price for Arm's processor designs. It also wants the jury to find that Arm tried to torpedo Qualcomm's dealings with Meta by leaking to Bloomberg an Arm letter in 2024 notifying Qualcomm it was allegedly in breach of a key license agreement.

Arm's legal team this week tried to focus the jury on its claim that Qualcomm had not suffered any harm from the allegations in its lawsuit, which Arm cast as an attempt to exert leverage as the two fought over licensing terms. A related bench trial also took place this week over whether Arm is negotiating in good faith over those terms, though a decision on that could come well after Friday's verdict. The trial in Wilmington, Delaware, federal court hinged on many of the same episodes as the 2024 trial in which Arm failed to convince a jury that Qualcomm had breached its licensing agreement with Arm. Both trials included testimony by both Arm CEO Rene Haas and Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon and were overseen by US District Judge Maryellen Noreika. Qualcomm's lawyer Karen Dunn said in her opening statement that the case was very serious for the company. "It’s really bad because Qualcomm’s entire chip business depends on Arm and on Arm honoring its contract and honoring its promises," she said on Monday. Qualcomm wanted Noreika to rule prior to trial that a clause in the licensing agreements meant that Qualcomm could stop paying royalties for five years if the contract were breached. She has not issued her ruling, and Arm has argued the royalty penalty is unenforceable. "They were not harmed in the least," Arm's attorney Gregg LoCascio told the jury on Monday.

Source: Reuters

TURIN, Oct 9 : Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa said on Friday the automaker's partnership with British startup Wayve could help slash development times and costs for advanced driver-assistance systems as carmakers race to bring autonomous features to market. Speaking alongside Wayve CEO Alex Kendall at the Wave technology event in Turin, Filosa said scale would be crucial to making hands-free driving affordable and accelerating adoption. "So as long as penetration follows the path that we believe is going to happen massively ... automotive scale, which is one of the complimentary assets that we bring to Alex, for instance, will decrease costs, which is very important, obviously," Filosa said, referring to so-called level 2++ driving assistance technology, which allows for hands-off driving while still requiring driver supervision. Reducing development timelines, currently around 24 months for Stellantis, was a key benefit of working with technology partners, he said.

Stellantis in May announced a partnership with Wayve to integrate the startup's AI-powered driving software into its STLA AutoDrive platform. Its first product launch is targeted for 2028 in North America. European regulators are still working to harmonise approval rules for increasingly sophisticated assisted-driving systems as automakers push for wider deployment. INTENSIFYING COMPETITION Traditional automakers initially aimed to develop advanced self-driving systems largely in-house, but with costs soaring and returns taking longer then expected, they are increasingly relying on specialist technology firms. Wayve is also working with other automakers, including Nissan and Mercedes, and has said its technology is designed to be deployed across multiple vehicle brands and markets. Kendall said Stellantis' portfolio of brands - which include Jeep, Fiat, Peugeot and Maserati - offered a unique opportunity to tailor autonomous driving characteristics across different vehicles while using the same underlying AI system. "One of the goals ... is the diversity of vehicles and brands that Stellantis have," he said. The partnership comes amid intensifying competition in automated driving. Tesla is pushing regulators across Europe to approve its Full Self-Driving technology, arguing advanced driver-assistance systems can improve road safety and accelerate adoption of autonomous features. At the Turin event, Stellantis and Wayve demonstrated hands-free driving in Fiat 500e and Maserati Grecale development vehicles, extending technology first shown on a Jeep Grand Cherokee earlier this year.

item.title: 中国、株式投信の設立要件を緩和 募集額引き下げ
item.description: [北京／上海 ９日 ロイター] - 中国証券監督管理委員会（ＣＳＲＣ）は９日、株式投資信託の設立要件を緩和する規則案...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国、株式投信の設立要件を緩和　募集額引き下げ 10/9 20:37 配信

北京の日の出、9月3日撮影 REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov

[北京／上海 ９日 ロイター] - 中国証券監督管理委員会（ＣＳＲＣ）は９日、株式投資信託の設立要件を緩和する規則案を公表した。中国の主要株価指数が１年超ぶりの安値に迫る中での措置となる。

ＣＳＲＣは声明で、規則改定は株式投信の発展を支援し、より多くの長期資金を株式市場に誘導することが目的と説明した。

規則案によると、株式投信の設立に必要な募集額を、現在の２億元から５０００万元（７４７万ドル）に引き下げる。

他の投資信託に投資するファンド・オブ・ファンズ（ＦＯＦ）にも要件緩和を適用する。一方、債券に投資する投信の要件は据え置く。

主要銘柄で構成するＣＳＩ３００指数は９日、人工知能（ＡＩ）サプライチェーン関連株の売りが一段と強まり、１年ぶりの安値に近い水準で引けた。

item.content:encoded:
Mark Trevelyan　Gleb Stolyarov

[ロンドン　９日　ロイター] - ウクライナは９日、ロシアのＩＴ企業ヤンデックスが運営する大規模データセンターを攻撃したと表明した。ロシアによるウクライナ国内のデータセンターへの攻撃を受け、ウクライナがロシア国内の攻撃対象を広げる中、ヤンデックス関連施設への攻撃は２日連続。ヤンデックスは数百万人が日常的に利用するサービスの維持が困難な状況に直面していると明らかにするなど、攻撃の応酬が続く中で双方の市民生活に影響が広がっている。

ヤンデックスはロシアの人工知能（ＡＩ）開発に深く関わり、「ロシアのグーグル」と呼ばれることもある。同社によると、モスクワ南西のカルーガ州にあるデータセンターがウクライナの無人機（ドローン）による攻撃を受け、一部が稼働を停止した。

ウクライナの兵器メーカー、ファイアポイントは、今回の攻撃に同社が開発した自爆型ドローン「ＦＰ－１」が投入されたと明らかにした。ヤンデックス最大のデータセンターに対する攻撃に使用され、施設内の複数のモジュールが完全に無力化されたとしている。

前日の攻撃では、モスクワ東南のリャザン州サソボにあるヤンデックスの主要データセンターがウクライナの攻撃を受け、稼働停止に追い込まれた。ヤンデックスは２０２１年、サソボのデータセンターについて、米半導体大手エヌビディアのＡ１００チップを搭載したスーパーコンピューター３基のうち２基が設置されていると明らかにしていた。これらは大規模ＡＩモデル「ヤンデックスＧＰＴ」の学習に使用されている。ヤンデックスは今回の攻撃でスーパーコンピューターが被害を受けたか明らかにしていない。

ヤンデックスはデータセンター５カ所を運営しているが、このうち２カ所が攻撃を受けた。同社は、顧客がデータやサービスを迅速に移行できるよう他のクラウドサービス事業者と提携したと発表。復旧に向けて２４時間体制で作業を続けているとしているが、復旧作業は容易ではないとしている。

ロシアは過去１カ月の間にウクライナのデータセンターや通信インフラに対する攻撃を強めており、首都キーウ中心部にある施設も標的になっていた。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は前日、ウクライナは同様の攻撃で対応すると表明しており、この日、カルーガ州のデータセンターへの攻撃はウクライナのドローンによるものだったと認め、「報復措置だ」と述べた。

カルーガ州知事によると、ウクライナによる今回の攻撃で少なくとも９人が負傷し、このうち５人が病院で治療を受けている。

Ｔインベストメンツの株式調査責任者、マリアナ・ラザリチェワ氏は、「リスクはヤンデックスのサービスが一時的に利用できなくなることや、一部事業での売上減少にとどまらない。同社は広範な法人顧客基盤を抱えている」と指摘。「ヤンデックスは他のデータセンターに負荷を分散できる可能性があるが、攻撃が連鎖的に続けばそうした選択肢は失われ、さらに深刻な結果に直面する恐れがある」と述べた。

モスクワ証券取引所に上場するヤンデックスの株価はこの日の取引で４％超下落した。

item.title: Teva wins FDA approval for monthly schizophrenia injection Weltruza
item.description: Teva said on Friday it had received approval from the US Food and Drug Administration for Weltruza, a once-monthly injection for adults with schizophrenia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Teva (TEVA.TA) said on Friday it had received approval from the US Food and Drug Administration for Weltruza, a once-monthly injection for adults with schizophrenia. Weltruza is the second US-approved product from Israel-based Teva's partnership with French biotech company Medincell (MEDCL.PA) after Uzedy, a long-acting injectable form of antipsychotic drug risperidone, which the FDA approved in 2023. Teva, which leads the development and commercialisation of Weltruza, said it expected to launch the drug in the US in the coming weeks The product uses Medincell's long-acting injectable technology, which is designed to release medicines over extended periods Analysts see potential for long-acting antipsychotic formulations to help address treatment-adherence challenges in chronic psychiatric illnesses, as long-acting olanzapine may in schizophrenia Medincell may be eligible for up to $112 million in additional development and commercial milestone payments under its agreement with Teva, along with royalties on sales Shares of Teva closed 2% higher in Tel Aviv; Medincell closed 16.9% higher in Paris (This story has been corrected to fix the sourcing in bullet point 3.)

item.title: 米デルタ航空、通期利益予想25％引き下げ 燃料費急騰で
item.description:
Rajesh Kumar Singh
[シカゴ ９日 ロイター] - 米デルタ航空は９日、通期の利益予想を中央値で約...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米デルタ航空、通期利益予想25％引き下げ　燃料費急騰で 10/9 20:06 配信

デルタ航空機、米ミネソタ州ミネアポリス・セントポール国際空港で2025年11月撮影 REUTERS/Tim Evans/File Photo

Rajesh Kumar Singh

[シカゴ ９日 ロイター] - 米デルタ航空は９日、通期の利益予想を中央値で約２５％引き下げた。旅行需要は堅調で航空券価格も上昇したが、燃料費の急増を補い切れなかった。

デルタは年間燃料費が前年より約６０億ドル増えると見込む。第３・四半期の燃料費は前年同期比６２％増の４１億ドルとなり、７月時点の想定を５億ドル超上回った。

エリック・スネル最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は記者団から利益予想引き下げの理由を問われ、「燃料が全てだ」と述べた。夏以降、原油と精製後のジェット燃料の両方が値上がりしたと指摘した。

通期の調整後１株利益予想は５．１０─５．６０ドルとし、７月時点の６．５０─７．５０ドルから引き下げた。新たな中央値の５．３５ドルは、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の５．４６ドルを下回る。２０２６年の調整後税引き前利益は４５億ドルを見込む。

第３・四半期決算は、調整後１株利益が１．７２ドルと、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の１．７６ドルをわずかに下回った。調整後営業利益率は１１．１％から９．４％に低下した。

デルタは需要が引き続き堅調だとしている。スネル氏によると、第４・四半期分は既に６０％近くが予約済みで、売上高は前年同期比約２０％増を見込む。

第４・四半期の調整後１株利益は１．１５─１．６５ドルを見込む。中央値の１．４０ドルは、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の１．３９ドルとほぼ一致した。

item.title: パレスチナ評議会選、情勢悪化で延期へ＝書簡
item.description: [パリ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ９日 ロイター] - ロイターが入手した書簡によると、パレスチナのシェイフ副大統領はフランスに対し、パレスチナ領域全体で情勢が悪化していることを理由に、１１月２８日に予定されていた評議会（議会）選を数カ月延期すると伝えた。

８日付のバロ仏外相宛て書簡は「日程設定の根拠として見込んでいた政治的、治安的、経済的状況が実現していないとの評価に達した」と説明。「現在の状況下で選挙を実施することは、その包摂性、参加の自由、選挙プロセスの公正性に影響を及ぼす根本的な障害に直面する」と付け加えている。

item.title: インド株式市場・引け＝反発、原油高止まりを依然懸念
item.description:
Bharath Rajeswaran Vivek Kumar M
[９日 ロイター] - インド株式市場は反発し、２５...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インド株式市場・引け＝反発、原油高止まりを依然懸念 10/9 19:44 配信

Bharath Rajeswaran　Vivek Kumar M

[９日 ロイター] - インド株式市場は反発し、２５年ぶりの長さとなった週間での下落が途切れた。ただ、金融引き締めや原油価格の高止まりへの懸念が重しとなり、上昇幅は小幅にとどまった。

ＮＳＥ指数は１．３％高の２万２５２０．４５、ＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は１．２３％高の７万２４７２．３３で終了した。業界大手タタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズ（ＴＣＳ）の決算で、ＡＩ関連収益の寄与拡大と堅調な海外事業の成長が示されたことを受け、ＩＴ株が相場を主導した。

ＮＳＥ指数とＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は週間でそれぞれ０．４％高、０．８％高となった。直近８週間ではそれぞれ８．７％、８．４％下落していた。

チョラマンダラム証券の株式調査責任者、ダルメシュ・カント氏は、「直近の下げで市場はテクニカル面で引き続き支えられるはずだ。企業の増益が期待通りに持続し、原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドルを下回る水準まで下落すれば、ＮＳＥ指数は約５％上昇する可能性がある」と述べた。

金融株指数は週間で１．７％上昇した。堅調な四半期業績の速報と、インド準備銀行（中央銀行）が今週、０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施した後に流動性吸収策を講じなかったことが支えとなった。

item.title: リフレ不要発言、賃金・物価の現状など踏まえたもの＝城内経財相
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ９日 ロイター］ - 城内実経済財政相は９日の定例会見で、リフレ政策が...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
リフレ不要発言、賃金・物価の現状など踏まえたもの＝城内経財相 10/9 19:26 配信

城内経財相。9月撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada

Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　９日　ロイター］ - 城内実経済財政相は９日の定例会見で、リフレ政策が必要な局面ではない、との自身および高市早苗首相の発言の真意について「賃金・物価の現状、ウクライナ侵略後の物価動向を踏まえたもの」と説明した。

城内経財相は９月２５日に「アベノミクス的な意味でのリフレ政策の局面は終わっている」と発言した。その真意について「２０２２年ごろから世界の原油価格が高騰し、海外の大きな変動に連動して日本の物価にも動きがみられ、物価の持続的下落という意味でデフレではない状況となった。賃金由来の要因による物価上昇が動き始めている」ことなどを列挙した。

具体例として、日銀が大規模な金融緩和として実施していた長短金利操作（イールドカーブコントロール）を２０２４年に撤廃し、金融市場の機能が回復し始めた点に言及した。

item.title: Wall Street set for weekly gains with earnings, inflation data on tap
item.description: Wall Street gained ground on Friday as investors shifted their focus to next week, with third-quarter earnings season set to start and inflation data expected, which could shed light on the Federal Reserve's next policy decision.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: Wall Street gained ground on Friday as investors shifted their focus to next week, with third-quarter earnings season set to start and inflation data expected, which could shed light on the Federal Reserve's next policy decision. All three major US stock indexes were modestly higher, paring gains after crude reversed an earlier dip and Treasury yields resumed their climb. All three indexes are poised to notch weekly gains, while the small-cap Russell 2000 (.RUT) is on course to end lower than last Friday's close. "It's the kind of back-and-forth market we've been in where we have the reversal of sentiment around Iran," said Ross Mayfield, investment strategy analyst at Baird in Louisville, Kentucky. "With conflicting headlines coming out of the White House and parties in the Middle East, there's just no edge there." "That's why it's a fairly tepid rally," Mayfield added. [USN:L1N45V03A TEXT:"Crude prices"] initially retreated after President Donald Trump said the US will not launch any attacks on Iran before the midterm elections, adding that talks between Washington and Tehran aimed at ending the market-rattling Iran war were "productive." Long-dated [USN:L1N45V0H5 TEXT:"US Treasury yields"] crept higher, but the benchmark 10-year yield remained below Wednesday's 24-year high. BANKS DUE TO REPORT EARNINGS Third-quarter reporting season begins in earnest next week, with big US banks Wells Fargo (WFC.N) , Goldman Sachs (GS.N) , Citigroup (C.N) , JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) , Bank of America (BAC.N) and Morgan Stanley (MS.N) scheduled to release results. Analysts estimate S&P 500 annual earnings growth of 30.6%, on aggregate, for the July-September period, with energy and technology leading the pack, posting year-on-year earnings growth of 123% and 66.5%, respectively, according to LSEG data. The mood of American consumers, who shoulder about 70% of the US economy, has soured this month, according to the University of Michigan, with near-term expectations deteriorating to an all-time low. The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 424.32 points, or 0.83%, to 51,655.96, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 44.96 points, or 0.58%, to 7,810.23 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gained 152.26 points, or 0.56%, to 27,345.60. Among the 11 major sectors of the S&P 500, communication services (.SPLRCL) was the lone percentage loser. AI-related momentum stocks were generally higher, with the Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF up 0.8% as the US bull market, largely driven by the AI boom, approaches its [USN:L6N45R12W TEXT:"four-year anniversary"]. Elon Musk's [USN:L6N45U1AK TEXT:"SpaceX"] (SPCX.O) struck a deal to acquire a nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio, posing a direct challenge to US wireless companies. Telecom firms T-Mobile US (TMUS.O) , AT&T (T.N) , and Verizon (VZ.N) dropped between 9.6% and 12.9%. [USN:L4N45V0SK TEXT:"Humana"] (HUM.N) jumped 12.2% after US government data showed 95% of the health insurer's members were in Medicare Advantage plans rated four stars or higher for 2027. [USN:L6N45V0A6 TEXT:"Apple"] (AAPL.O) slid 1.5% after a media report that the iPhone maker has told some suppliers to cut production of components for its newly launched iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, as soaring memory chip costs and price increases dampen consumer demand. [USN:L1N45V0AC TEXT:"Delta Air Lines"] (DAL.N) dropped 1.2%, as the company cut its annual profit forecast by nearly a quarter at the midpoint of the range. Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.65-to-1 ratio on the NYSE. There were 98 new highs and 141 new lows on the NYSE. On the Nasdaq, 2,690 stocks rose and 1,947 fell as advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.38-to-1 ratio. The S&P 500 posted 11 new 52-week highs and five new lows while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 35 new highs and 173 new lows.

item.title: 中国、成長目標達成に向け財政刺激策を強化
item.description: [北京／香港 ９日 ロイター] - 中国財政省は９日、成長目標達成に向けて地方政府の財政を支え、インフラ投資を拡大...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国、成長目標達成に向け財政刺激策を強化 10/9 19:23 配信

北京の日の出、9月3日撮影 REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov

[北京／香港 ９日 ロイター] - 中国財政省は９日、成長目標達成に向けて地方政府の財政を支え、インフラ投資を拡大するため、未使用の政府債務枠５５００億元（８２０億ドル）を割り当てた。

うち３０００億元は、県級政府の日常業務を支援するために充てられ、残りはインフラプロジェクト、特に建設中のプロジェクトや、経済的に力強い地域でのプロジェクトに充てられるという。

政策当局者は過去２年間も、年末の財政刺激策として未使用の政府債務枠を活用してきたが、今年は２０２４年と２５年の額を上回っている。

同省は別の声明で、より積極的な財政政策を「力強くかつ効果的に」実施し、内需の拡大を支援すると表明した。

Money market funds attract massive inflows as bond selloff bit

FAST

Oct 9 : Global money market funds drew strong inflows in the week ended October 7 as a global bond selloff, concerns over government debt levels in parts of Europe and lingering inflation fears pushed investors toward safer assets. Investors bought global money market funds of a net $153.81 billion during the week, registering their largest weekly net purchase since May 6, LSEG Lipper data showed. French bonds came under selling pressure last week, pushing the 10-year yield to a 24-year high of 4.994 per cent, amid concerns over the country's wide budget deficit exceeding 5 per cent of GDP and a potentially divisive presidential election next year. The US 10-year Treasury yield also climbed to a 24-1/2-year high of 5.3645 per cent on Wednesday, as higher oil prices raised fears that inflation could prove more persistent than expected.

Investors, meanwhile, made net purchases of $560 million in global equity funds — the smallest weekly inflow in three weeks. European equity funds attracted $6.19 billion, their largest weekly inflow in four weeks. Investors also added a net $6.16 billion to Asian equity funds, but withdrew $5.11 billion from U.S. funds. Among sectoral funds, technology, utilities and industrials recorded notable inflows of $5.37 billion, $1.10 billion and $1.03 billion, respectively. Financial sector funds, however, saw weekly outflows of $3.47 billion. Global bond funds drew $26.03 billion in the week, their largest weekly inflow since July 8. Short-term bond funds gained $9.36 billion, marking their largest weekly inflow in three months. Government bond funds and loan participation funds also recorded notable inflows of $4.65 billion and $1.89 billion, respectively. Among commodity funds, gold and other precious metals funds recorded a fourth consecutive week of net purchases, totalling $1.41 billion. Investors also bought $269 million worth of energy funds. In emerging markets, bond funds attracted $1.48 billion in weekly inflows, broadly reversing the prior week's $1.86 billion in outflows. Equity funds, however, recorded a fifth consecutive weekly outflow of $752 million, according to data covering 27,895 funds.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ノーベル平和賞にピレイ元ＩＣＣ判事、ガザ「集団虐殺」報告主導
item.description:
Gwladys Fouche Nora Buli
[オスロ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gwladys Fouche　Nora Buli

[オスロ ９日 ロイター] - ノルウェーのノーベル賞委員会は９日、ナビ・ピレイ元国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）判事にノーベル平和賞を授与すると発表した。ピレイ氏はイスラエルがパレスチナ自治区ガザでジェノサイド（集団虐殺）を行ったと結論付けた国連報告書の取りまとめを主導した。

委員会は授賞理由として「平和と国際法の促進に向けた努力」を挙げた。今年の平和賞は、国際社会の秩序を維持する重要性を示すものだと説明した。

「国際法の体系は大きな圧力にさらされ、その諸機関は攻撃を受けている」と指摘した。「法の枠組みや、法と正義を尊重する国際社会の姿勢が損なわれ、力の政治へと移行しつつある。力が正義に勝れば、必ず安定と信頼、平和的共存が脅かされる」と訴えた。

ピレイ氏（８５）は南アフリカ東部ナタール州ダーバンで、インド系タミル人の家庭に生まれた。ＩＣＣやルワンダ国際刑事裁判所など、複数の国際裁判所で判事を務めた。

また、イスラエルがガザでジェノサイドを行ったと２０２５年に結論付けた国連のパレスチナ自治区に関する調査委員会の委員長を務めた。イスラエルはこの報告書を「言語道断だ」と退けた。国連人権高等弁務官も務めた。

１９６７年にはナタール州で女性として初めて法律事務所を開設し、南アの高等裁判所で非白人女性として初めて判事を務めた。

＜揺るぎない倫理観＞

委員会はピレイ氏が国家や指導者の責任を追及し、暴力や紛争の被害者に希望をもたらしたほか、長年にわたる活動で揺るぎない倫理観を示したと評価した。

「アパルトヘイト（人種隔離政策）に立ち向かった（元南ア大統領）ネルソン・マンデラ氏らを弁護した初期の活動から、現代の重要な国際裁判で判事を務めたことまで、その姿勢は一貫している」と述べた。

ＩＣＣに対しては、トランプ米大統領が圧力を強めており、米国は赤根智子所長や複数の検察官と判事に制裁を科した。トランプ氏は９月、各国にＩＣＣからの脱退を呼びかけた。

オスロ国際平和研究所のホーコン・イェルロウ所長代行は、委員会がピレイ氏への平和賞授与でトランプ氏を直接批判したわけではないとの見方を示した。「むしろ国際法に基づく世界秩序を後押しするものだと思う。もちろん、ＩＣＣに関わった人物の受賞に（トランプ氏が）反応する可能性はあるが、トランプ氏への直接的な攻撃ではない」と述べた。

＜ニュルンベルクで受賞の知らせを聞く＞

ピレイ氏は、ドイツのニュルンベルクで法律関係の会議に出席中、受賞の知らせを受けた。会場の建物は、ナチスの犯罪を裁くため１９４５─４６年に初の国際軍事裁判所が設置された場所だった。

人権団体アムネスティ・インターナショナルの代表が交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に投稿した動画によると、ピレイ氏は受賞を祝って集まった人々に「直近で手掛けたのは、ガザで起きていることをジェノサイドと認定した報告書の提出だ」と語った。

さらに「もう少し拍手してくれれば、この賞をトランプ氏と分け合うかもしれない」と述べ、笑いを誘った。昨年の平和賞受賞者マリア・コリナ・マチャド氏が、ベネズエラの民主化運動への支持を得るため、１月に自身のノーベル賞メダルをトランプ氏に贈った判断を念頭に置いた発言とみられる。

ノーベル賞委員会のヨルゲン・バトネ・フリードネス委員長 はロイターに対し、平和を確保するために築かれた国際体制が「大きな圧力」にさらされており、「最も強大な国々には特別な責任があるが残念ながら世界中でこうした状況が見られる。諸機関が攻撃を受けている。多くの判事が制裁を科されている」と語った。

ＩＣＣの赤根所長は、声明で受賞を歓迎し「国際法秩序と法の支配が深刻な課題に直面する中、今回の評価には特別な意義がある」と表明した。

平和賞の賞金は１２００万スウェーデンクローナ（約１２０万ドル）。授賞式は１２月１０日にオスロで開かれる予定だ。

item.title: Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種企業、第3四半期は31％増益へ ＡＩ関連けん引
item.description:
Caroline Valetkevitch
[ニューヨーク ９日 ロイター] - 米国企業は第３・四半期に再び大幅な増...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種企業、第3四半期は31％増益へ　ＡＩ関連けん引 10/9 19:07 配信

2025年5月9日、米オレゴン州ハーミストンにあるアマゾン・ウェブ・サービス（ＡＷＳ）のデータセンター。 REUTERS/Noah Berger for AWS/File Photo

Caroline Valetkevitch

[ニューヨーク ９日 ロイター] - 米国企業は第３・四半期に再び大幅な増益を達成する見込みで、株式市場の上昇と同様、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業がけん引している。

ＬＳＥＧによると、アナリストは第３・四半期のＳ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の利益が前年同期比で平均約３１％増加すると予想しており、その増加分の３分の２はハイテクセクターとＡＩ大手アルファベット、アマゾン、メタ・プラットフォームズによるもの。来週にはＪＰモルガン・チェースやゴールドマン・サックスなど銀行の決算発表で第３・四半期決算シーズンが始まる。

ウェルズ・ファーゴ・インベストメント・インスティテュートのグローバル株式・実物資産担当責任者サミール・サマナ氏は「全てはＡＩによるもので、エネルギーと素材も多少影響しているが、それは地政学的な要因によるものだ。成長の７０─８０％がハイテクとＡＩによるものだとしても驚かない」と語る。

エネルギー部門の利益は前年比約１１５％増加すると見込まれている。米原油価格はイラン戦争が続いているため、第３・四半期に約３０％急騰した。

サマナ氏は、生活必需品部門と不動産部門を挙げ、これらが前年比増益率予測が最も低い部類に入ると指摘した。

アメリプライズ・フィナンシャルのチーフ市場ストラテジスト、アンソニー・サグリンベネ氏は「投資家にとって懸念されるのは収益成長がピークに近づいている点だ」と話す。

ＬＳＥＧのデータに基づくと、ＡＩブーム最大の受益分野の一つである米半導体企業の利益は、第２・四半期の約１５８％増に対し、第３・四半期は約１３６％増加したもよう。

独立系調査会社アーニングス・スカウトのニック・ライヒ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）氏は「業績予想修正の勢いは鈍化し始めている。ＡＩインフラの構築は今も時速１００マイルで進んでいるが、３カ月前は時速１５０マイルだった」と述べた。

投資家は、今回の決算発表シーズンにおいて、金利上昇が企業利益にどのような影響を与えるかにも目を配りそうだ。

前出のサマナ氏によると、公益部門のような多額の借り入れを行っている企業は危険にさらされている。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ企業、臨床試験の成否をシミュレーションで予測 アングル：エヌビディア、ＡＩ半導体担保の巨大融資市場構想、資産価値巡りウォール街と溝 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か 最終更新: 10/9(金) 19:07 ロイター

item.title: AI-centered US stock bull market nears four-year anniversary
item.description: NEW YORK, Oct 9 : The US bull market is going strong as it nears its four-year anniversary, driven by an AI spending engine that is propelling corporate profits and economic growth.The S&P 500 is trading around record-high levels ahead of October 12, which will mark four years since the benchmark stock index

item.content:encoded:

AI-centered US stock bull market nears four-year anniversary

FILE PHOTO: A street sign for Wall Street is seen outside the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City, New York, U.S., July 19, 2021. REUTERS/Andrew Kelly/File Photo

FILE PHOTO: A view shows the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) Wall Street entrance in New York City, U.S., April 7, 2025. REUTERS/Kylie Cooper/File Photo

09 Oct 2026 06:05PM (Updated: 09 Oct 2026 07:14PM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 9 : The US bull market is going strong as it nears its four-year anniversary, driven by an AI spending engine that is propelling corporate profits and economic growth. The S&P 500 is trading around record-high levels ahead of October 12, which will mark four years since the benchmark stock index's closing low for this cycle — signaling the start of the latest bull run. Sizzling corporate profit growth — lifted by spending on the AI expansion and a solid economic backdrop — has helped drive the latest leg of the market's rally and is a primary reason for investor optimism in coming quarters. But even as the index climbs, risks loom. The Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes and spiking US Treasury yields both provide obstacles that could sap the momentum for equities. Markets could be volatile heading into next month's US midterm elections.

The market's dependence on AI also presents a worry, with any hints of weakness in the trend possibly met with severe punishment. "The AI theme is the defining feature of this bull market," said Anthony Saglimbene, chief market strategist at Ameriprise. "What you're seeing in terms of the bull market four years in is, I think, the easy money around AI has been made ... as we get further into this bull market, there is just going to be more pressure on especially technology companies to prove that the spending that they're doing today is actually going to translate into the profits." CURRENT RUN RANKS MIDDLE-AGED AMONG BULLS As bull markets go, the current one could be classified as middle-aged. The S&P 500's latest run ranks as the eighth-longest bull market since World War Two, according to Ryan Detrick, chief market strategist at Carson Group. While stock experts differ on defining a bull market, a common definition is a gain of at least 20 per cent that has followed a decline of at least 20 per cent from a peak. The current bull run has tallied a gain of 117 per cent, which is the sixth-best-performing bull market since World War Two. "Four years is not, by any stretch of the imagination, scary with regards to a bull market," said Mark Hackett, chief market strategist for Nationwide. "They don't end of old age; they end from disease." TECH, AI AT HEART OF BULL RUN AI has dominated the latest bull run, with the launch of ChatGPT coming about a month after the bull market began. US companies are posting massive profit growth, with S&P 500 earnings expected to rise more than 35 per cent this year, boosted by capital spending from "hyperscalers" to build data centers. Oxford Economics estimates about one-third of recent US economic growth stems from AI, including the net impact of direct investment to support expansion of AI infrastructure as well as some contribution from the wealth effect from stock market gains lifting consumer spending. "You're seeing that AI theme show up in the economy and in corporate profits," Saglimbene said. Of the 11 S&P 500 sectors, only technology and communication services — which includes megacap AI players Alphabet and Meta Platforms — have posted stronger gains than the index itself during the bull run. The market capitalization of Nvidia — whose AI chips have made the company the poster child of this technological era — has soared to $5.8 trillion from $286 billion on October 12, 2022. It has become the largest company by market value in the world. Thirteen US companies boast market values of at least $1 trillion — all but two either in the tech sector or with significant AI exposure. CONCENTRATION RISK GROWS WITH TECH DOMINANCE The gains in massive tech and AI stocks give them more significant sway over major stock indexes, but also make them top-heavy. The weight of the top 10 companies in the S&P 500 has grown to about 40 per cent from about 28 per cent in October 2022, according to J.P. Morgan Asset Management. "It is a reflection of fundamental strength and earnings outperformance, but also it introduces some risks," said Angelo Kourkafas, senior global investment strategist at Edward Jones. "The risk of concentration is that if the prevailing theme goes out of favor, portfolios might feel it in an outsized way." Another risk is the Fed's recent pivot to rate hikes, as the US central bank seeks to bring down high inflation. Tighter monetary policy could slow the economy, perhaps severely. Indeed, the last bear market that led to the low in October 2022 coincided with a sharp rate-hiking cycle. Rate hikes also factor in to the huge jump in Treasury yields. The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield was hovering at around 5.2 per cent, after recently reaching its highest level in 24 years. Higher yields pose headwinds for equities, including potentially greater investment competition from bonds. Kourkafas said Edward Jones remains overweight equities but the recommendation is less aggressive than it was before, with the strategist noting the increasing attractiveness of fixed income. "We still think that the bull market is not about to end ... but it makes sense to us to take some of the risk off the table," he said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: AI-related companies to drive most third-quarter US earnings gains
item.description: NEW YORK, Oct 9 : US companies are likely to deliver another earnings surge for the third quarter, and like the rally in the stock market, AI-related players are fueling most of those gains.While investors are enthusiastic about the hyper earnings growth fueled by AI companies, many are also worried about how

AI-related companies to drive most third-quarter US earnings gains

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 9 : US companies are likely to deliver another earnings surge for the third quarter, and like the rally in the stock market, AI-related players are fueling most of those gains. While investors are enthusiastic about the hyper earnings growth fueled by AI companies, many are also worried about how long the trend can continue, and what will happen to share prices when it ends. Analysts on average expect S&P 500 earnings to rise about 31 per cent year-over-year for the third quarter, with two-thirds of that leap coming from the technology sector and AI heavyweights Alphabet, Amazon.com and Meta Platforms, according to Tajinder Dhillon, LSEG's head of earnings and equity research. Tech share gains helped the S&P 500 reach a record high this week ahead of the earnings season, which is expected to unofficially kick off next week with results from banks including JPMorgan Chase and Goldman Sachs.

"It's all AI and, to a lesser extent, energy and materials, but that's because of geopolitics," said Sameer Samana, head of global equities and real assets at Wells Fargo Investment Institute. "It wouldn't surprise me if 70-80 per cent of the growth can be attributed to tech and AI." Energy earnings are seen up about 115 per cent from a year ago, with US oil prices having surged roughly 30 per cent in the third quarter because of the ongoing US-Israeli war with Iran. "Almost as telling is if you look at the sectors that are not related to AI at all," Samana said, pointing to consumer staples and real estate, whose year-over-year earnings growth estimates for the third quarter are among the weakest. Still, strategists are not sure if third-quarter earnings growth can surpass the banner growth of the second quarter. The majority of companies tend to beat analysts' estimates, and that is likely to be the case again in the third-quarter season. Year-over-year S&P 500 earnings grew in the second quarter by nearly 54 per cent, the highest since 2021, LSEG data showed. Excluding mark-to-market gains at Alphabet and Amazon.com on AI-related investments, that growth was about 35 per cent, still the highest since 2021. "A concern for investors is we are kind of approaching peak earnings growth" for the current cycle, said Anthony Saglimbene, chief market strategist at Ameriprise Financial. "A lot of this AI trade is built on continued capex spending, and every quarter we go, and they continue to spend, the hurdle rates get higher and the scrutiny gets larger." Earnings for US semiconductor companies, among the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, are expected to have increased about 136 per cent in the third quarter compared with about 158 per cent in the second quarter, Dhillon said, based on LSEG data. "Earnings estimate revision momentum is starting to cool," said Nick Raich, CEO of the Earnings Scout, an independent research firm. "We're still going 100 miles an hour in the AI infrastructure buildout, but three months ago we were going 150 miles an hour." Raich said the most recent reports including from Micron Technology have been strong and suggest other companies are still "reaping the benefits." Chipmaker Micron last month forecast quarterly revenue above estimates and said customers had increased commitments under its long-term supply agreements to $32 billion. This week Google entered a massive power deal with Constellation Energy. Investors are also likely to pay close attention this earnings season to how higher interest rates may be affecting corporate profits. US bond yields have risen because of concerns about inflation, higher oil prices and debt problems in France and elsewhere. Heavy borrowers, such as utilities, are at risk, Samana said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米国民の78％、物価高の責任はトランプ政策 共和支持者4割不満
item.description:
Howard Schneider Ann Saphir Jason Lange
［ワシントン ９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir　Jason Lange

［ワシントン　９日　ロイター］ - 米国民の７８％が、収入の伸びを上回る物価上昇の責任はトランプ米大統領の政策にあると考えていることが、ロイター／イプソスの最新の世論調査で明らかになった。共和党支持者の５７％が、物価の伸びが給与の伸びを上回っていると回答した。１１月の中間選挙を前に、共和、民主両党いずれの支持者も過半数が生活費を最大の懸念とした。

調査は５日まで実施し、米国の成人４５０６人から回答を得た。誤差は米国民全体でプラスマイナス２ポイント、共和党支持者、民主党支持者、無党派層ではそれぞれ同３ポイント。

トランプ氏の経済運営を支持しない割合は、共和党支持者で約２５％、無党派層が６３％、民主党支持者は９２％だった。インフレ対応への評価はさらに厳しく、回答者全体の６８％、共和党支持者の４０％が不満を示した。

＜「何もかも値上がりした」＞

全米のガソリン平均価格は８日時点で１ガロン＝４．３６ドルで、１年前の３．１１ドルから上昇。軽油価格は記録的な上昇を経て６．２８ドルとなった。カンザス州などの農業州で、その影響が最も強く感じられている。

カンザス州カンザスシティーに住むヒスパニック系のアシーナ・バレットさん（４１）は、「ガソリン、食料品、生活費、何もかも値上がりした」と述べ、トランプ大統領の仕事ぶりに不満を示した。

ヒスパニック系有権者は２４年の大統領選で多くがトランプ氏を支持したが、世論調査では支持が低下している。

回答者は、投票先を決める上での重要課題として生活費を挙げた。過去１年間で生活費が「大幅に上昇した」と感じている人は５４％（共和党支持者では４０％）。「わずかに上昇した」は３０％、「変わらない」は１０％だった。

回答者の約７８％（共和党支持者の６４％、無党派層の７６％を含む）は、ホワイトハウスにも一定の責任があると答えた。米国民の大半は、関税を物価高の重要な要因と見なしている。

＜支出への影響は限定的＞

ただ今回の調査では、支出を切り詰めている兆候は限られていた。外食の頻度を減らしたと答えた割合は全体の約６３％、娯楽や動画配信サービスへの支出を減らしたと答えたのは５６％。車の運転を減らしている、あるいは支払いが滞っているとの回答は、これより少なかった。

経済指標を見ると、税金や物価上昇を考慮しても、米国民の所得は全体としてなお小幅に増えている。時間当たり賃金の伸びは全体として消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）とほぼ同じペースにとどまっている。

有権者はトランプ政権の政策の一部にはなお共感している。回答者の４５％が、不法移民を物価高の根本的な原因に挙げた。

item.title: Huracán Simón se intensifica rápidamente en su camino a costa de México
item.description: El huracán Simón se intensificaba rápidamente el viernes a medida que se acercaba a la costa occidental de México, donde tocará tierra como un "peligroso" huracán el fin de semana, dijeron autoridades y agencias meteorológicas.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Becerril
item.content:encoded: El huracán Simón se [USN:L6N45U1C2 TEXT:"intensificaba rápidamente"] el viernes a medida que se acercaba a la costa occidental de México, donde tocará tierra como un "peligroso" huracán el fin de semana, dijeron autoridades y agencias meteorológicas. A las 11.00 hora local (1700 GMT) Simón se ubicaba a unos 335 kilómetros al sur de la ciudad portuaria Manzanillo y soplaba vientos máximos sostenidos de 155 kilómetros por hora (km/h), con ráfagas más fuertes, mientras se desplazaba lentamente hacia el noroeste a 4 km/h, dijo el Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos (NHC, por su sigla en inglés). "Se pronostica que Simón se intensificará rápidamente y se acercará a la costa de México como un peligroso huracán mayor este fin de semana", sostuvo el NHC, con sede en Miami. "Se deben completar los preparativos hoy mismo", agregó. Simón tocará tierra la mañana del domingo como un huracán de categoría 4 en la escala de Saffir-Simpson entre Manzanillo, el mayor puerto de México y principal puerta de entrada del comercio con Asia, y Puerto Vallarta, un popular destino de playa cuyo municipio homónimo alberga a casi 300,000 habitantes. Un huracán de categoría 4 sopla vientos destructivos de hasta 250 km/h, descarga lluvias torrenciales y marejadas ciclónicas peligrosas. Además, puede dejar a su paso daños generalizados en estructuras protectoras, desplome de tejados en edificios pequeños e inundaciones en terrenos interiores. "Simón podría provocar el impacto más significativo de un huracán en este tramo de la costa del Pacífico mexicano desde Lidia en 2023, que dañó miles de viviendas y arrasó cultivos en la costa de Jalisco", dijo Tyler Roys, meteorólogo experto de AccuWeather. Simon llevaría humedad tropical al suroeste de Estados Unidos la próxima semana. Se prevén precipitaciones de 25 a 50 milímetros (mm) en gran parte de Nuevo México, el este de Arizona, el sur de Colorado y el oeste de Texas, con la posibilidad de acumular de 50 a 100 mm en el sur de Nuevo México. La semana pasada, [USN:L6N45L0YK TEXT:"Polo tocó tierra"] como un huracán de categoría 2 en la Península de Baja California dejando árboles y postes caídos, calles inundadas y otros daños materiales. Simon no será el único sistema tropical que afectará a México durante el fin de semana. Se pronostica que la tormenta Rachel toque tierra en Baja California, provocando nuevos impactos tropicales en el país y el suroeste de Estados Unidos. El sábado, [USN:L6N45U16I TEXT:"Isaías"] tocará tierra en el estado Florida como un huracán mayor.

item.title: 中国国慶節、国内旅行1回当たり支出4年ぶり低水準 海外旅行増
item.description:
Sophie Yu Julie Zhu
[北京／香港 ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sophie Yu　Julie Zhu

[北京／香港 ９日 ロイター] - 今年の中国国慶節休暇期間中（１０月１─７日）の国内旅行１回当たりの平均支出額は前年比１．９％減の８９３．９２元（１３３．５１ドル）と、新型コロナウイルス流行に伴う規制で最も厳しかった時期に６８０．６０元にまで落ち込んだ２０２２年以来の低水準となった。堅調な旅行需要が個人消費の広範な回復を後押しするという期待は打ち砕かれた。

９日に公表された政府データに基づきロイターが算出した。

中国では近年、長期化する不動産市場の低迷、賃金上昇の鈍化、雇用市場の軟調さが家計心理を圧迫しており、個人消費は依然として低迷が続いている。

方徳証券のシニアアナリスト、エイルサ・リャオ氏は「われわれの見解では、主な制約要因は消費意欲の欠如ではなく、収入や雇用の見通しに対する不確実性にある」と述べた。

連休中は映画チケットの売上も落ち込んだ。

国慶節の連休は通常、春節（旧正月）と並んで中国で最も興行収入が見込まれる時期の一つ。しかし、中国の映画業界分析プラットフォーム「猫眼」のデータによると、今年の興行収入は前年比３６．６％減の１１億６０００万元にとどまり、１４年以来の低水準となった。

その代わりに、中国の消費者は海外旅行を選ぶようになった。

今回の連休は昨年より１日短かったものの、多くの旅行者がこれを９月２５日から２７日にかけての中秋節の連休と組み合わせ、最大１３日間の休暇を確保。旅行予約サイト、トリップ・ドット・コム・グループによると、同サイトを通じて予約された海外行きの航空券の半数以上が１０月１日より前の出発便で、平均旅行日数は９日間を超えた。

また、７泊以上の海外ホテル宿泊の予約は前年比１２３％増となり、複数の目的地を巡る旅程の予約も８４％増加したという。

item.title: 諮問会議の民間議員、骨太目標で提言 「未達の兆しなら成長戦略など見直しを」
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　９日　ロイター］ - 政府が９日に開いた経済財政諮問会議で、民間議員らが「骨太の方針（経済財政運営と改革の基本方針）」に盛り込まれた中長期の経済財政計画について、目標達成が危ぶまれる場合には成長戦略や歳出・歳入など政策の枠組みを見直すよう提言した。

高市政権が７月に決定した骨太の方針は、中長期的な経済財政政策の目標として、実質１％超、名目３％超の経済成長率のほか、２０４０年度に国内投資２５０兆円、ＧＤＰ１１００兆円を実現することや、債務残高対ＧＤＰ比の安定的な引き下げを掲げている。

これらの目標について、「目標の実現が困難となるおそれを示す重要な兆し」が見られた場合には、「必要に応じて成長戦略の再構築、歳出・歳入の見直し等につなげる運営の仕組みを構築すべき」とした。

また、リーマン危機や新型コロナウイルスの世界的流行のような経済ショックが発生した場合には、債務残高対ＧＤＰ比が一時的に悪化しても歳出を急激に抑制しないよう、「柔軟性を確保する仕組み」も必要だと指摘した。

item.title: 米政権の永住権手続き凍結、インドＩＴ企業への影響は限定的か
item.description:
Kashish Tandon Bharath Rajeswaran
[９日 ロイター] - 高度な技能を持つ外国人労働...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米政権の永住権手続き凍結、インドＩＴ企業への影響は限定的か 10/9 18:27 配信

タタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズ（ＴＣＳ）のロゴと、その前に配置された人形。2024年2月19日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Kashish Tandon　Bharath Rajeswaran

[９日 ロイター] - 高度な技能を持つ外国人労働者の永住権申請手続きの一部を米トランプ政権が凍結したことについて、アナリストらは９日、インドのＩＴ企業が短期的に打撃を受ける可能性は低いとの見方を示した。大手ＩＴ企業はこの制度への依存を減らしているためだ。

米国が停止対象としたのは、「永久労働認定制度（ＰＥＲＭ）」。米国内の外国生まれの人を減らし、永住権や市民権の取得を制限する幅広い取り組みの一環だ。

今回の措置は米マイクロソフト、コグニザント、印インフォシス、タタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズ（ＴＣＳ）、ウィプロ、ＨＣＬテクノロジーズ、仏キャップジェミニを対象としている。

インド外務省は９日、今回の措置は両国が共有する目標の実現につながらないと批判した。「この件に関する米副大統領の発言も承知している。こうした表現は不当であり、米国で働くインド人専門職が高い教育と技能を備え、米国の経済やイノベーションを支える仕組みに貢献している事実を無視している」と指摘した。

バンス米副大統領は具体的な根拠を示さないまま、企業がＰＥＲＭ制度を利用して米国人従業員を外国人労働者に置き換え、賃金を押し下げていると主張していた。

ＩＣＩＣＩ証券は、今回の動きはインドＩＴ株にとって短中期的にマイナスだと分析した。主な理由として「目先の売上高への影響ではなく」、投資家心理の悪化と長期的な人材確保への懸念を挙げた。

同証券によると、２０２４年１０月─２５年９月に提出されたＰＥＲＭ申請のうち、インドのＩＴ企業が占めた割合は２％未満にとどまった。永住権取得を巡る不透明感が長引けば、米国で働く従業員の離職が増える可能性があると指摘した。

インドのＩＴ業界団体ＮＡＳＳＣＯＭは８日夜、ＩＴ企業が近年、米国での現地採用を拡大する一方、Ｈ－１Ｂビザへの依存を大幅に減らしてきたと説明した。Ｈ－１Ｂビザで働く人のうち、ＰＥＲＭの労働認定を経て永住権を取得する人は比較的少ないという。

インド最大のＩＴサービス輸出企業タタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズは、過去２年間のＰＥＲＭ申請が１桁にとどまっていることを理由に、今回の停止が人員戦略や顧客との取引に影響するとは見込んでいないと述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ネパール土石流でインド人多数が行方不明、ヒンドゥー教聖地巡礼者ら アングル：人材確保に苦戦する南ア衣料工場、移民排斥運動で働き手流出 焦点：インドで強まるＺ世代の影響力、変化迫られるモディ首相 アングル：インド「ゴキブリ人民党」運動がＺ世代に爆発的人気、政権の安定イメージに揺らぎ 焦点：ＡＩに置き換えられるインドのコールセンター労働者 最終更新: 10/9(金) 18:27 ロイター

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝上昇、午後にはセンチメント改善
item.description: [上海 ９日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は主要指数が小幅高。午後には前場の下げから戻したが１年ぶりの安値付近で引けた...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝上昇、午後にはセンチメント改善 10/9 18:22 配信

[上海 ９日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は主要指数が小幅高。午後には前場の下げから戻したが１年ぶりの安値付近で引けた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連のサプライチェーン銘柄が売られた。香港株はインターネット企業の値上がりを背景に上昇した。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．２％高、上海総合指数は０．１％高で終了。香港のハンセン指数は１．８％上昇した。

週間では、ＣＳＩ３００指数は１％近く下落し、９週連続の下げとなった。ハンセン指数は１％高だった。

５Ｇ通信指数は一時６％下落し、２カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。ハイテク関連中心の上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は一時４％下落し、５カ月ぶりの安値を付けた後、ほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。

午後の取引ではセンチメントが改善し、ファーテン・ベリエンウォルド（華泰柏瑞）ＣＳＩ３００ＥＴＦなど、一部の主要大型株・小型株ＥＴＦの売買高が約２カ月ぶりの高水準に達した。

ＡＩデータセンター向け光トランシーバーの大手メーカー、中際旭創は１％安。メモリー半導体大手、長鑫存儲技術（ＣＸＭＴ）は１％高で引けた。

石炭指数は１．４％高、生活必需品株指数は０．８％高となり、投資家はリスク抑制のためディフェンシブ銘柄や伝統的セクターへと乗り換えた。

香港市場のハイテク大手株は反発し、３．１％上昇した。ただ、指数は２年ぶりの安値付近で推移している。

中国人民銀行（中央銀行）は８日、為替政策に対する海外からの批判に反論し、競争的な通貨切り下げを行ったことはないと表明した。欧州の政策当局者は、中国の記録的な貿易黒字と輸出急増を抑制するために人民元の上昇を求めている。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：中国肝いりの物流情報網、忽然と姿消す　「通商上の兵器」と米が危惧 コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：中国政府、株市場てこ入れ作戦に公的年金基金も動員 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：経済モデル転換目指す中国、不動産不況でも資源需要衰えず 最終更新: 10/9(金) 18:22 ロイター

item.title: 欧州当局、サウジ飛行回避勧告を拡大 リヤド便の運休相次ぐ
item.description:
Timour Azhari Tala Ramadan
[リヤド／ドバイ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timour Azhari　Tala Ramadan

[リヤド／ドバイ ９日 ロイター] - 欧州航空安全庁（ＥＡＳＡ）は９日、サウジ北西部の空域を飛行回避勧告の対象に追加した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるリヤド空港への攻撃を受け、９月３０日に初めて発出した紛争地域に関する情報を更新した。最近の攻撃は、フーシ派が首都を含むサウジ領内の深部にある標的を攻撃する能力と意図を持つことを示したと説明した。

サウジの航空当局によると、首都リヤドのキング・ハーリド国際空港で８日に起きた２件の攻撃により、サウジ国民３人が死亡、数人が負傷した。最初の攻撃は空港施設を標的としたもので、２回目の攻撃はサウジ国営航空会社サウディアに所属する航空機を標的としたものだったという。攻撃により物的損害も生じたが、空港の運営は再開された。

フーシ派は８日、同空港をミサイルで攻撃したと表明していた。また、ナジュラーンの空港も標的にしたと主張している。さらにハミース・ムシャイトの空軍基地も弾道ミサイルで攻撃したとしている。

ＥＡＳＡは「こうしたミサイルや無人機による攻撃の繰り返しと防空システムの作動により、民間航空機を誤認するリスクが高まっているほか、ミサイルや無人機の飛行、迎撃活動、破片の落下に伴うリスクも生じている」と説明した。

航空関係者約１万人が加盟し、飛行リスク情報を共有する会員制組織ＯＰＳＧＲＯＵＰは９日、ミサイル攻撃が続くリスクや防空対応での「判断ミス」の危険性を理由に、サウジでの運航を避けるよう会員に警告した。ロイターが入手した会員向け通知で「現在、サウジ国内での運航を全面的に避けるよう勧告している。飛行経路上の代替着陸先としてサウジの空港を利用することも含む」とした。

＜ルフトハンザとインド航空３社が運休＞

８日の攻撃を受け、ルフトハンザ・グループとインドの航空会社３社は、今後数日間に予定されているリヤド便を運休すると発表した。

リヤドのキング・ハーリド国際空港は、ジェッダに次いでサウジで２番目に発着便数が多い空港。サウジ統計総局によると、２０２５年の発着便数は２９万６８００便で、１日当たり約８１３便に相当する。

航空機追跡サイト「フライトレーダー２４」によると、９日１３０５ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後１０時０５分）時点で、リヤド発着の１３１便が欠航した。前日も数百便が欠航していた。

在アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）の米大使館は、サウジ国内の民間施設などを狙ったフーシ派の攻撃に言及し、米国人に警戒を強めるよう呼びかけた。戦闘が急速に激化する恐れがあるとした。

リヤドでは１１日から、各国の石油相や政府当局者、石油会社幹部が集まるＷＰＣエナジー・コングレスが予定されているが、９日時点では開催を告知している。イタリアのエネルギー相は、現地には行かずビデオ形式で参加すると表明した。

＜フーシ派の攻撃激化＞

米国とイランの紛争を発端とする戦争が激化する中、フーシ派は、サウジの空域は自らのミサイル部隊の作戦区域だとし、９日にはイスラム教の聖地メッカとメディナの上空を除くサウジ上空を飛行する航空機への威嚇を繰り返した。

フーシ派関係者と関連メディアによると、サウジは夜間にイエメンの首都サヌアのフーシ派拠点を空爆した。イエメン政府軍を支援するサウジ主導の有志連合は、フーシ派が使用していたミサイル発射台３基を破壊したとし、民間人への攻撃には断固として対応すると表明した。

フーシ派はイエメン第３の都市タイズで政府軍を包囲しており、紅海沿岸の拠点防衛を試みている。同派は今週、サウジの空港への攻撃で既に３人を殺害していた。

サウジの駐イエメン大使は９日、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で、バベルマンデブからフーシ派を排除したと述べた。ロイターはこれを確認していない。北に位置するモカにはフーシ派部隊が残っており、政府軍が近隣の丘陵地帯で戦闘に注力している。

item.title: 世界成長率、26年は2.6％に鈍化見通し＝ＵＮＣＴＡＤ
item.description:
[９日 ロイター] - 国連貿易開発会議（ＵＮＣＴＡＤ）は９日、中東危機に伴うエネルギーショックが世界経済を試練にさらす中、２０２６年の世界経済成長率は２．６％となり、２５年の２．９％から鈍化するという見通しを示した。
ＵＮＣＴＡＤの報告書によると、世界のモノ（財）・サービス貿易は２５年に過去最高の３５兆ドルに達した後、２６年は実質ベースで４％拡大する見通し。ただ、拡大の主因はエネルギー価格の上昇という。
詳細は以下の通り。
• 米中間の貿易は２４年以降、２０％超減少した一方、東アジアは中国、北米の双方との貿易を拡大している。
• ＵＮＣＴＡＤは「輸出規制、投資審査、サプライチェーン（供給網）の状況により、戦略的分野への新規参入が難しくなっている」と指摘した。
• アジアは２６年の世界経済成長の５９％を担う見通し。インドは７．３％、中国は４．５％、インドネシアは５．２％の成長が見込まれている。
